3. **Quality**: Should produce reasonable routes at all scales
4. **Correctness**: Output must be a valid permutation of 0..N-1 starting with 0

Given a list of cities, find the shortest round-trip route that visits every city exactly once and returns to the start. This is one of the most famous hard problems in computer science — checking every possible route is only feasible for a handful of cities, so the AI must use clever shortcuts to find a good route quickly.

Subpasses scale from 10 cities up to 1 000, so brute-force is impossible for the larger cases. The AI's route length is compared against a simple baseline; beating it earns full marks.

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <numeric>
#include <random>

using namespace std;
using namespace std::chrono;

double get_time_sec() {
    return duration_cast<duration<double>>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}

uint64_t hilbert_index(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint64_t d = 0;
    for (int s = 31; s >= 0; s--) {
        uint32_t rx = (x >> s) & 1;
        uint32_t ry = (y >> s) & 1;
        d = (d << 2) | ((rx * 3) ^ ry);
        if (ry == 0) {
            if (rx == 1) {
                x = ~x;
                y = ~y;
            }
            uint32_t t = x;
            x = y;
            y = t;
        }
    }
    return d;
}

inline double distance_nodes(int a, int b, const float* x, const float* y) {
    double dx = x[a] - x[b];
    double dy = y[a] - y[b];
    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
}

void reverse_segment(vector<int>& tour, int start, int end) {
    int n = tour.size();
    while (start != end) {
        int next_start = (start + 1 < n) ? start + 1 : start + 1 - n;
        if (next_start == end) {
            swap(tour[start], tour[end]);
            break;
        }
        swap(tour[start], tour[end]);
        start = next_start;
        end = (end - 1 >= 0) ? end - 1 : end - 1 + n;
    }
}

void apply_2opt(vector<int>& tour, const float* x, const float* y, int window, int max_passes, double start_time, double time_limit) {
    int N = tour.size();
    if (N < 3) return;
    int passes = 0;
    bool improved = true;
    while (improved && passes < max_passes) {
        improved = false;
        passes++;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if ((i & 1023) == 0 && get_time_sec() - start_time > time_limit) {
                return;
            }
            int a = tour[i];
            int i_next = (i + 1 < N) ? i + 1 : i + 1 - N;
            int b = tour[i_next];
            
            int limit = min(N - 1, window);
            double best_delta = -1e-7;
            int best_j = -1;
            
            double dist_ab = distance_nodes(a, b, x, y);
            
            int j = (i_next + 1 < N) ? i_next + 1 : i_next + 1 - N;
            for (int k = 2; k <= limit; k++) {
                int j_next = (j + 1 < N) ? j + 1 : j + 1 - N;
                int c = tour[j];
                int d = tour[j_next];
                
                double dist_cd = distance_nodes(c, d, x, y);
                double dist_ac = distance_nodes(a, c, x, y);
                double dist_bd = distance_nodes(b, d, x, y);
                
                double delta = dist_ac + dist_bd - dist_ab - dist_cd;
                if (delta < best_delta) {
                    best_delta = delta;
                    best_j = j;
                }
                j = j_next;
            }
            
            if (best_j != -1) {
                reverse_segment(tour, i_next, best_j);
                improved = true;
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    double start_time = get_time_sec();
    
    int N;
    if (!(cin >> N)) return 0;
    if (N <= 0) return 0;
    
    vector<float> x(N), y(N);
    if (!(cin >> x[0] >> y[0])) return 0;
    float min_x = x[0], max_x = x[0];
    float min_y = y[0], max_y = y[0];
    
    int actual_N = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) {
        if (!(cin >> x[i] >> y[i])) break;
        if (x[i] < min_x) min_x = x[i];
        if (x[i] > max_x) max_x = x[i];
        if (y[i] < min_y) min_y = y[i];
        if (y[i] > max_y) max_y = y[i];
        actual_N++;
    }
    N = actual_N;
    if (N < x.size()) {
        x.resize(N);
        y.resize(N);
    }
    
    if (N == 1) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    float range_x = max_x - min_x;
    float range_y = max_y - min_y;
    float max_range = max(range_x, range_y);
    if (max_range == 0) max_range = 1.0f;
    
    vector<pair<uint64_t, int>> h_points(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        float norm_x = (x[i] - min_x) / max_range;
        float norm_y = (y[i] - min_y) / max_range;
        if (norm_x > 1.0f) norm_x = 1.0f;
        if (norm_y > 1.0f) norm_y = 1.0f;
        if (norm_x < 0.0f) norm_x = 0.0f;
        if (norm_y < 0.0f) norm_y = 0.0f;
        uint32_t sx = (uint32_t)(norm_x * 2147483647.0f);
        uint32_t sy = (uint32_t)(norm_y * 2147483647.0f);
        h_points[i] = {hilbert_index(sx, sy), i};
    }
    
    sort(h_points.begin(), h_points.end());
    
    vector<int> tour(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        tour[i] = h_points[i].second;
    }
    
    int window = 50;
    if (N <= 5000) window = N;
    else if (N <= 20000) window = 1000;
    else if (N <= 100000) window = 400;
    else if (N <= 1000000) window = 200;
    else window = 100;
    
    // First fast pass for larger N to resolve local tangles quickly
    if (N > 1000) {
        apply_2opt(tour, x.data(), y.data(), min(20, window), 100, start_time, 290.0);
    }
    
    // Main 2-opt pass
    apply_2opt(tour, x.data(), y.data(), window, 100, start_time, 290.0);
    
    // Extreme optimization for small sets using multi-start local search
    if (N <= 1000) {
        vector<int> best_tour = tour;
        double best_len = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            best_len += distance_nodes(best_tour[i], best_tour[(i+1)%N], x.data(), y.data());
        }
        
        mt19937 rng(1337);
        int max_retries = (N <= 100) ? 5000 : 200;
        for (int r = 0; r < max_retries; r++) {
            if (get_time_sec() - start_time > 280.0) break;
            vector<int> curr = tour;
            shuffle(curr.begin(), curr.end(), rng);
            apply_2opt(curr, x.data(), y.data(), N, 50, start_time, 280.0);
            
            double curr_len = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                curr_len += distance_nodes(curr[i], curr[(i+1)%N], x.data(), y.data());
            }
            if (curr_len < best_len) {
                best_len = curr_len;
                best_tour = curr;
            }
        }
        tour = best_tour;
    }
    
    // Rotate tour to start at city 0
    int zero_idx = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (tour[i] == 0) {
            zero_idx = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        int idx = (zero_idx + i < N) ? zero_idx + i : zero_idx + i - N;
        cout << tour[idx];
        if (i != N - 1) cout << ' ';
    }
    cout << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}

You are solving the Chinese Postman Problem (Route Inspection Problem) in C#.

You must write a C# solver that can handle ANY graph size from trivial to ludicrous scale:
- **Trivial**: 6-20 nodes, 8-45 edges (small graphs, exact algorithms feasible)
- **Medium**: 35-200 nodes, 80-600 edges (requires efficient algorithms)
- **Large**: 500-1000 nodes, 2000-5000 edges (requires optimized implementations)
- **Extreme**: 5000-10000 nodes, 30000-80000 edges (requires very fast algorithms)

**The Challenge:**
Your program will be tested with graphs ranging from 6 nodes to 100000 nodes. The same function must work efficiently across ALL scales.

**Input format (stdin):**
Line 1: N M (number of nodes, number of edges)

**Output format (stdout):**
A sequence of node indices (whitespace-separated) representing a route that starts at node 0,
traverses EVERY edge at least once, and returns to node 0.
You may optionally prefix with a single integer L (route length). If present, it must match the number of nodes listed.

**Critical Requirements:**
1. **Scalability**: Your algorithm must adapt based on graph size and complexity
2. **Performance**: Must complete within 30 seconds even for large graphs
3. **Correctness**: Must traverse every edge at least once

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

class Program
{
    struct Edge
    {
        public int to;
        public int weight;
        public int id;
    }

    static int nextEdgeId;
    static bool[] edgeUsed;
    static List<Edge>[] adj;

    static void AddDuplicateEdge(int u, int v, int w)
    {
        adj[u].Add(new Edge { to = v, weight = w, id = nextEdgeId });
        adj[v].Add(new Edge { to = u, weight = w, id = nextEdgeId });
        if (nextEdgeId >= edgeUsed.Length)
        {
            Array.Resize(ref edgeUsed, edgeUsed.Length * 2 + 1000);
        }
        nextEdgeId++;
    }

    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(Console.OpenStandardInput());
        int N = scanner.NextInt();
        if (N == -1) return;
        int M = scanner.NextInt();

        adj = new List<Edge>[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) adj[i] = new List<Edge>();

        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++)
        {
            int u = scanner.NextInt();
            int v = scanner.NextInt();
            int w = scanner.NextInt();
            adj[u].Add(new Edge { to = v, weight = w, id = i });
            adj[v].Add(new Edge { to = u, weight = w, id = i });
        }

        if (M == 0)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("0");
            return;
        }

        int[] degree = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) degree[i] = adj[i].Count;

        List<int> oddList = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            if (degree[i] % 2 != 0) oddList.Add(i);
        }
        int[] oddVertices = oddList.ToArray();
        int k = oddVertices.Length;

        edgeUsed = new bool[Math.Max(M, 1)];
        nextEdgeId = M;

        int[] visitedGen = new int[N];
        int currentGen = 0;

        if (k > 0)
        {
            if (k <= 20)
            {
                // Exact Minimum Weight Perfect Matching using DP for small scale
                long[][] oddDist = new long[k][];
                int[][] oddParentNode = new int[k][];

                for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
                {
                    oddDist[i] = new long[N];
                    oddParentNode[i] = new int[N];
                    Array.Fill(oddDist[i], long.MaxValue / 2);

                    PriorityQueue<int, long> pq = new PriorityQueue<int, long>();
                    pq.Enqueue(oddVertices[i], 0);
                    oddDist[i][oddVertices[i]] = 0;

                    currentGen++;
                    visitedGen[oddVertices[i]] = currentGen;

                    while (pq.Count > 0)
                    {
                        pq.TryDequeue(out int curr, out long d);
                        if (d > oddDist[i][curr]) continue;

                        foreach (var edge in adj[curr])
                        {
                            int nxt = edge.to;
                            long nxt_d = d + edge.weight;
                            if (visitedGen[nxt] != currentGen || nxt_d < oddDist[i][nxt])
                            {
                                oddDist[i][nxt] = nxt_d;
                                visitedGen[nxt] = currentGen;
                                oddParentNode[i][nxt] = curr;
                                pq.Enqueue(nxt, nxt_d);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                long[] dp = new long[1 << k];
                int[] dpPrev = new int[1 << k];
                Array.Fill(dp, long.MaxValue / 2);
                dp[0] = 0;

                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << k); mask++)
                {
                    if (dp[mask] == long.MaxValue / 2) continue;

                    int u = -1;
                    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
                    {
                        if ((mask & (1 << i)) == 0)
                        {
                            u = i;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (u == -1) continue;

                    for (int v = u + 1; v < k; v++)
                    {
                        if ((mask & (1 << v)) == 0)
                        {
                            int nextMask = mask | (1 << u) | (1 << v);
                            long cost = dp[mask] + oddDist[u][oddVertices[v]];
                            if (cost < dp[nextMask])
                            {
                                dp[nextMask] = cost;
                                dpPrev[nextMask] = mask;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                int currMask = (1 << k) - 1;
                while (currMask > 0)
                {
                    int prevMask = dpPrev[currMask];
                    int diff = currMask ^ prevMask;
                    int u = -1, v = -1;
                    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
                    {
                        if ((diff & (1 << i)) != 0)
                        {
                            if (u == -1) u = i;
                            else v = i;
                        }
                    }

                    int currNode = oddVertices[v];
                    while (currNode != oddVertices[u])
                    {
                        int pNode = oddParentNode[u][currNode];
                        long w = oddDist[u][currNode] - oddDist[u][pNode];
                        AddDuplicateEdge(pNode, currNode, (int)w);
                        currNode = pNode;
                    }

                    currMask = prevMask;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // Greedy Matching for highly optimized large scale graphs
                bool[] unmatchedNode = new bool[N];
                foreach (var o in oddVertices) unmatchedNode[o] = true;

                long[] dist = new long[N];
                int[] parentNode = new int[N];
                PriorityQueue<int, long> pq = new PriorityQueue<int, long>();

                for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
                {
                    int u = oddVertices[i];
                    if (!unmatchedNode[u]) continue;

                    unmatchedNode[u] = false;

                    currentGen++;
                    pq.Enqueue(u, 0);
                    dist[u] = 0;
                    visitedGen[u] = currentGen;

                    int v = -1;
                    while (pq.Count > 0)
                    {
                        pq.TryDequeue(out int curr, out long d);
                        if (d > dist[curr]) continue;

                        if (unmatchedNode[curr])
                        {
                            v = curr;
                            break;
                        }

                        foreach (var edge in adj[curr])
                        {
                            int nxt = edge.to;
                            long nxt_d = d + edge.weight;
                            if (visitedGen[nxt] != currentGen || nxt_d < dist[nxt])
                            {
                                dist[nxt] = nxt_d;
                                visitedGen[nxt] = currentGen;
                                parentNode[nxt] = curr;
                                pq.Enqueue(nxt, nxt_d);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (v != -1)
                    {
                        unmatchedNode[v] = false;
                        int currNode = v;
                        while (currNode != u)
                        {
                            int pNode = parentNode[currNode];
                            long w = dist[currNode] - dist[pNode];
                            AddDuplicateEdge(pNode, currNode, (int)w);
                            currNode = pNode;
                        }
                    }

                    pq.Clear();
                }
            }
        }

        // Hierholzer's algorithm to find the Eulerian Circuit
        List<int> circuit = new List<int>();
        Stack<int> stack = new Stack<int>();
        stack.Push(0);

        int[] head = new int[N];

        while (stack.Count > 0)
        {
            int curr = stack.Peek();
            bool foundUnused = false;

            while (head[curr] < adj[curr].Count)
            {
                var edge = adj[curr][head[curr]];
                head[curr]++;
                if (!edgeUsed[edge.id])
                {
                    edgeUsed[edge.id] = true;
                    stack.Push(edge.to);
                    foundUnused = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!foundUnused)
            {
                circuit.Add(curr);
                stack.Pop();
            }
        }

        // Output formatting: High throughput stream writer
        using (StreamWriter sw = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), bufferSize: 65536))
        {
            for (int i = circuit.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                sw.Write(circuit[i]);
                if (i > 0) sw.Write(" ");
            }
            sw.WriteLine();
        }
    }
}

class Scanner
{
    Stream stream;
    byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 64];
    int head = 0;
    int tail = 0;

    public Scanner(Stream stream)
    {
        this.stream = stream;
    }

    public int NextInt()
    {
        int c = Read();
        while (c <= 32)
        {
            if (c == -1) return -1;
            c = Read();
        }
        bool neg = false;
        if (c == '-')
        {
            neg = true;
            c = Read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c > 32)
        {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = Read();
        }
        return neg ? -res : res;
    }

    int Read()
    {
        if (head >= tail)
        {
            head = 0;
            tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
            if (tail == 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[head++];
    }
}

use std::io::{self, Read};
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::time::Instant;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Point {
    x: f32,
    y: f32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Edge {
    u: usize,
    v: usize,
}

struct Node {
    mass: f32,
    com_x: f32,
    com_y: f32,
    min_x: f32,
    min_y: f32,
    max_x: f32,
    max_y: f32,
    child: usize,
    point_idx: usize,
}

fn get_child(cx: f32, cy: f32, p: &Point) -> usize {
    let dx = if p.x < cx { 0 } else { 1 };
    let dy = if p.y < cy { 0 } else { 1 };
    dx + (dy << 1)
}

fn insert(tree: &mut Vec<Node>, node_idx: usize, p_idx: usize, pos: &[Point], depth: usize) {
    if depth > 60 { return; }
    
    if tree[node_idx].child == 0 {
        if tree[node_idx].point_idx == usize::MAX {
            tree[node_idx].point_idx = p_idx;
            return;
        }
        
        let existing_idx = tree[node_idx].point_idx;
        tree[node_idx].point_idx = usize::MAX;
        
        let cx = (tree[node_idx].min_x + tree[node_idx].max_x) * 0.5;
        let cy = (tree[node_idx].min_y + tree[node_idx].max_y) * 0.5;
        let first_child = tree.len();
        tree[node_idx].child = first_child;
        
        for i in 0..4 {
            let dx = i & 1;
            let dy = (i >> 1) & 1;
            tree.push(Node {
                mass: 0.0, com_x: 0.0, com_y: 0.0,
                min_x: if dx == 0 { tree[node_idx].min_x } else { cx },
                min_y: if dy == 0 { tree[node_idx].min_y } else { cy },
                max_x: if dx == 0 { cx } else { tree[node_idx].max_x },
                max_y: if dy == 0 { cy } else { tree[node_idx].max_y },
                child: 0, point_idx: usize::MAX,
            });
        }
        
        let c1 = get_child(cx, cy, &pos[existing_idx]);
        insert(tree, first_child + c1, existing_idx, pos, depth + 1);
        let c2 = get_child(cx, cy, &pos[p_idx]);
        insert(tree, first_child + c2, p_idx, pos, depth + 1);
        return;
    }
    
    let cx = (tree[node_idx].min_x + tree[node_idx].max_x) * 0.5;
    let cy = (tree[node_idx].min_y + tree[node_idx].max_y) * 0.5;
    let c = get_child(cx, cy, &pos[p_idx]);
    let first_child = tree[node_idx].child;
    insert(tree, first_child + c, p_idx, pos, depth + 1);
}

fn compute_mass(tree: &mut Vec<Node>, node_idx: usize, pos: &[Point]) {
    if tree[node_idx].child == 0 {
        if tree[node_idx].point_idx != usize::MAX {
            tree[node_idx].mass = 1.0;
            let p = pos[tree[node_idx].point_idx];
            tree[node_idx].com_x = p.x;
            tree[node_idx].com_y = p.y;
        } else {
            tree[node_idx].mass = 0.0;
            tree[node_idx].com_x = 0.0;
            tree[node_idx].com_y = 0.0;
        }
        return;
    }
    
    let first_child = tree[node_idx].child;
    let mut mass = 0.0;
    let mut com_x = 0.0;
    let mut com_y = 0.0;
    for i in 0..4 {
        compute_mass(tree, first_child + i, pos);
        let child_mass = tree[first_child + i].mass;
        mass += child_mass;
        com_x += tree[first_child + i].com_x * child_mass;
        com_y += tree[first_child + i].com_y * child_mass;
    }
    
    tree[node_idx].mass = mass;
    if mass > 0.0 {
        tree[node_idx].com_x = com_x / mass;
        tree[node_idx].com_y = com_y / mass;
    }
}

fn build_tree(pos: &[Point]) -> Vec<Node> {
    let mut tree = Vec::with_capacity(pos.len() * 4);
    let mut min_x = f32::MAX;
    let mut min_y = f32::MAX;
    let mut max_x = f32::MIN;
    let mut max_y = f32::MIN;
    for p in pos {
        if p.x < min_x { min_x = p.x; }
        if p.y < min_y { min_y = p.y; }
        if p.x > max_x { max_x = p.x; }
        if p.y > max_y { max_y = p.y; }
    }
    
    let cx = (min_x + max_x) * 0.5;
    let cy = (min_y + max_y) * 0.5;
    let size = ((max_x - min_x).max(max_y - min_y) * 0.5 + 0.1).max(1.0);
    
    tree.push(Node {
        mass: 0.0, com_x: 0.0, com_y: 0.0,
        min_x: cx - size, min_y: cy - size,
        max_x: cx + size, max_y: cy + size,
        child: 0, point_idx: usize::MAX,
    });
    
    for (i, _) in pos.iter().enumerate() {
        insert(&mut tree, 0, i, pos, 0);
    }
    compute_mass(&mut tree, 0, pos);
    tree
}

fn compute_force(tree: &[Node], node_idx: usize, p: &Point, theta: f32, k: f32, fx: &mut f32, fy: &mut f32) {
    let node = &tree[node_idx];
    if node.mass == 0.0 { return; }
    
    let mut dx = node.com_x - p.x;
    let mut dy = node.com_y - p.y;
    let mut dist_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    
    if dist_sq < 1e-6 {
        dx = 0.01;
        dy = 0.01;
        dist_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    }
    
    let size = node.max_x - node.min_x;
    if node.child == 0 || size * size < theta * theta * dist_sq {
        let factor = node.mass * (k * k) / dist_sq;
        *fx -= dx * factor;
        *fy -= dy * factor;
    } else {
        let first_child = node.child;
        for i in 0..4 {
            compute_force(tree, first_child + i, p, theta, k, fx, fy);
        }
    }
}

fn initialize_positions(n: usize, adj: &[Vec<usize>]) -> Vec<Point> {
    let mut pos = vec![Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 }; n];
    let mut visited = vec![false; n];
    let mut components = Vec::new();
    
    for i in 0..n {
        if !visited[i] {
            let mut comp = Vec::new();
            let mut q = VecDeque::new();
            q.push_back(i);
            visited[i] = true;
            
            while let Some(u) = q.pop_front() {
                comp.push(u);
                for &v in &adj[u] {
                    if !visited[v] {
                        visited[v] = true;
                        q.push_back(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            components.push(comp);
        }
    }
    
    let box_size = (n as f32).sqrt() * 1.5;
    let mut rng_seed = 12345u32;
    let mut rand_f32 = || -> f32 {
        rng_seed = rng_seed.wrapping_mul(1664525).wrapping_add(1013904223);
        (rng_seed as f32) / (u32::MAX as f32)
    };
    
    let mut dist = vec![usize::MAX; n];
    
    for comp in components {
        if comp.is_empty() { continue; }
        
        let cx = (rand_f32() - 0.5) * box_size;
        let cy = (rand_f32() - 0.5) * box_size;
        
        let mut best_u = comp[0];
        let mut max_deg = adj[best_u].len();
        for &u in &comp {
            if adj[u].len() > max_deg {
                max_deg = adj[u].len();
                best_u = u;
            }
        }
        
        let mut q = VecDeque::new();
        q.push_back(best_u);
        dist[best_u] = 0;
        
        let mut layers: Vec<Vec<usize>> = Vec::new();
        
        while let Some(u) = q.pop_front() {
            let d = dist[u];
            if d >= layers.len() {
                layers.resize(d + 1, Vec::new());
            }
            layers[d].push(u);
            for &v in &adj[u] {
                if dist[v] == usize::MAX {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.push_back(v);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for &u in &comp {
            dist[u] = usize::MAX;
        }
        
        let layer_dist = 1.0; 
        for (d, nodes) in layers.iter().enumerate() {
            let r = d as f32 * layer_dist;
            let count = nodes.len();
            if count == 1 {
                pos[nodes[0]] = Point { x: cx, y: cy };
            } else {
                let angle_step = 2.0 * std::f32::consts::PI / count as f32;
                for (i, &u) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {
                    let angle = i as f32 * angle_step;
                    pos[u] = Point {
                        x: cx + r * angle.cos(),
                        y: cy + r * angle.sin(),
                    };
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (i, p) in pos.iter_mut().enumerate() {
        p.x += (i as f32 * 0.001).fract();
        p.y += (i as f32 * 0.0013).fract();
    }
    
    pos
}

fn main() {
    let mut input = String::new();
    if io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut input).is_err() { return; }
    let mut tokens = input.split_whitespace();
    
    let n_str = tokens.next();
    if n_str.is_none() { return; }
    let n: usize = match n_str.unwrap().parse() {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    let m: usize = match tokens.next().unwrap_or("0").parse() {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    
    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    let mut edges = Vec::with_capacity(m);
    
    for _ in 0..m {
        if let (Some(u_str), Some(v_str)) = (tokens.next(), tokens.next()) {
            let u: usize = u_str.parse().unwrap_or(n);
            let v: usize = v_str.parse().unwrap_or(n);
            if u < n && v < n {
                adj[u].push(v);
                adj[v].push(u);
                edges.push(Edge { u, v });
            }
        }
    }
    
    if n == 0 { return; }
    
    let k = 1.0;
    let time_limit = 28.0; 
    let max_iters = 800;
    
    let mut pos = initialize_positions(n, &adj);
    let start_time = Instant::now();
    
    let mut temp = (n as f32).sqrt() * 0.5;
    if temp < 5.0 { temp = 5.0; }
    let initial_temp = temp;
    
    let num_threads = std::thread::available_parallelism().map(|n| n.get()).unwrap_or(4).max(1);
    
    let mut disp = vec![Point { x: 0.0, y: 0.0 }; n];
    
    for iter in 0..max_iters {
        if iter % 5 == 0 && start_time.elapsed().as_secs_f64() > time_limit {
            break;
        }
        
        let tree = build_tree(&pos);
        
        let chunk_size = (pos.len() + num_threads - 1) / num_threads;
        let mut pos_chunks = pos.chunks(chunk_size);
        let mut disp_chunks = disp.chunks_mut(chunk_size);
        
        std::thread::scope(|s| {
            for (p_chunk, d_chunk) in pos_chunks.by_ref().zip(disp_chunks.by_ref()) {
                let tree_ref = &tree;
                s.spawn(move || {
                    for i in 0..p_chunk.len() {
                        let mut fx = 0.0;
                        let mut fy = 0.0;
                        compute_force(tree_ref, 0, &p_chunk[i], 1.2, k, &mut fx, &mut fy);
                        d_chunk[i].x = fx;
                        d_chunk[i].y = fy;
                    }
                });
            }
        });
        
        for e in &edges {
            let mut dx = pos[e.v].x - pos[e.u].x;
            let mut dy = pos[e.v].y - pos[e.u].y;
            let mut dist_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            if dist_sq < 1e-6 {
                dx = 0.01;
                dy = 0.01;
                dist_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            }
            let dist = dist_sq.sqrt();
            
            let factor = dist / k;
            let fx = dx * factor;
            let fy = dy * factor;
            
            disp[e.u].x += fx;
            disp[e.u].y += fy;
            disp[e.v].x -= fx;
            disp[e.v].y -= fy;
        }
        
        for i in 0..n {
            let dx = 0.0 - pos[i].x;
            let dy = 0.0 - pos[i].y;
            let factor = 0.05 * k;
            disp[i].x += dx * factor;
            disp[i].y += dy * factor;
        }
        
        for i in 0..n {
            let dx = disp[i].x;
            let dy = disp[i].y;
            let d_mag = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt();
            
            if d_mag > 1e-6 {
                let move_dist = d_mag.min(temp);
                pos[i].x += dx / d_mag * move_dist;
                pos[i].y += dy / d_mag * move_dist;
            }
        }
        
        let progress = (iter as f32) / (max_iters as f32);
        temp = initial_temp * (1.0 - progress).max(0.01);
    }
    
    for p in pos {
        println!("{:.4} {:.4}", p.x, p.y);
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>
#include <algorithm>
#include <map>

using namespace std;

struct Point {
    double x, y, z;
    Point() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y, double z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
    Point operator-(const Point& o) const { return Point(x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z); }
    Point operator+(const Point& o) const { return Point(x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z); }
    Point operator*(double s) const { return Point(x * s, y * s, z * s); }
    double length() const { return sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z); }
    void normalize() {
        double l = length();
        if (l > 1e-12) { x /= l; y /= l; z /= l; }
    }
};

double dot(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
}

Point cross(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    return Point(a.y*b.z - a.z*b.y, a.z*b.x - a.x*b.z, a.x*b.y - a.y*b.x);
}

struct Face {
    int a, b, c;
    Point normal;
    double d;
};

vector<Face> build_convex_hull(const vector<Point>& pts) {
    int n = pts.size();
    if (n < 4) return {};
    
    int p0 = 0, p1 = -1, p2 = -1, p3 = -1;
    double max_d = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        double d = (pts[i] - pts[p0]).length();
        if (d > max_d) { max_d = d; p1 = i; }
    }
    if (p1 == -1) return {};
    
    max_d = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i == p0 || i == p1) continue;
        Point v = pts[i] - pts[p0];
        Point dir = pts[p1] - pts[p0]; dir.normalize();
        double proj = dot(v, dir);
        Point perp = v - dir * proj;
        double d = perp.length();
        if (d > max_d) { max_d = d; p2 = i; }
    }
    if (p2 == -1) return {};
    
    max_d = 0;
    Point n0 = cross(pts[p1] - pts[p0], pts[p2] - pts[p0]); n0.normalize();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i == p0 || i == p1 || i == p2) continue;
        double d = abs(dot(n0, pts[i] - pts[p0]));
        if (d > max_d) { max_d = d; p3 = i; }
    }
    if (p3 == -1) return {};
    
    vector<Face> faces;
    auto add_face = [&](int a, int b, int c, int d_idx) {
        Face f; f.a = a; f.b = b; f.c = c;
        f.normal = cross(pts[b] - pts[a], pts[c] - pts[a]);
        f.normal.normalize();
        if (dot(f.normal, pts[d_idx] - pts[a]) > 0) {
            swap(f.b, f.c);
            f.normal = cross(pts[f.b] - pts[a], pts[f.c] - pts[a]);
            f.normal.normalize();
        }
        f.d = dot(f.normal, pts[a]);
        faces.push_back(f);
    };
    
    add_face(p0, p1, p2, p3);
    add_face(p0, p1, p3, p2);
    add_face(p0, p2, p3, p1);
    add_face(p1, p2, p3, p0);
    
    vector<bool> used(n, false);
    used[p0] = used[p1] = used[p2] = used[p3] = true;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (used[i]) continue;
        vector<Face> next_faces;
        map<pair<int, int>, int> edge_counts;
        bool visible = false;
        
        for (const auto& f : faces) {
            if (dot(f.normal, pts[i]) > f.d + 1e-9) {
                visible = true;
                edge_counts[{f.a, f.b}]++;
                edge_counts[{f.b, f.c}]++;
                edge_counts[{f.c, f.a}]++;
            } else {
                next_faces.push_back(f);
            }
        }
        
        if (!visible) continue;
        
        for (auto const& [edge, _] : edge_counts) {
            if (edge_counts.find({edge.second, edge.first}) == edge_counts.end()) {
                int u = edge.first;
                int v = edge.second;
                Face f;
                f.a = u; f.b = v; f.c = i;
                f.normal = cross(pts[v] - pts[u], pts[i] - pts[u]);
                f.normal.normalize();
                f.d = dot(f.normal, pts[u]);
                next_faces.push_back(f);
            }
        }
        faces = next_faces;
    }
    
    return faces;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int V;
    double E;
    if (!(cin >> V >> E)) return 0;
    
    vector<Point> pts(V);
    double Xmin = 1e18, Xmax = -1e18, Ymin = 1e18, Ymax = -1e18, Zmin = 1e18, Zmax = -1e18;
    for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
        cin >> pts[i].x >> pts[i].y >> pts[i].z;
        Xmin = min(Xmin, pts[i].x); Xmax = max(Xmax, pts[i].x);
        Ymin = min(Ymin, pts[i].y); Ymax = max(Ymax, pts[i].y);
        Zmin = min(Zmin, pts[i].z); Zmax = max(Zmax, pts[i].z);
    }
    
    vector<Face> hull = build_convex_hull(pts);
    if (hull.empty()) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    // Using Circumradius to ensure no overlap for any orientation
    double R_in = E * sqrt(3.0 / 8.0);
    double R_margin = R_in * 1.000000001 + 1e-9;
    double S = sqrt(2.0) * R_margin;
    
    vector<double> top_Nx, top_Ny, top_Nz_inv, top_K;
    vector<double> bot_Nx, bot_Ny, bot_Nz_inv, bot_K;
    vector<double> vrt_Nx, vrt_Ny, vrt_K;
    
    for (const auto& f : hull) {
        if (f.normal.z > 1e-7) {
            top_Nx.push_back(f.normal.x);
            top_Ny.push_back(f.normal.y);
            top_Nz_inv.push_back(1.0 / f.normal.z);
            top_K.push_back(f.d - R_margin);
        } else if (f.normal.z < -1e-7) {
            bot_Nx.push_back(f.normal.x);
            bot_Ny.push_back(f.normal.y);
            bot_Nz_inv.push_back(1.0 / f.normal.z);
            bot_K.push_back(f.d - R_margin);
        } else {
            vrt_Nx.push_back(f.normal.x);
            vrt_Ny.push_back(f.normal.y);
            vrt_K.push_back(f.d - R_margin);
        }
    }
    
    long long min_i = floor(Xmin / S) - 2;
    long long max_i = ceil(Xmax / S) + 2;
    long long min_j = floor(Ymin / S) - 2;
    long long max_j = ceil(Ymax / S) + 2;
    
    long long num_columns = (max_i - min_i + 1) * (max_j - min_j + 1);
    long long ops_per_offset = num_columns * (long long)hull.size();
    long long max_ops = 500000000; // 5e8 operations limit to stay well within 30s
    int num_offsets = 1;
    
    if (num_columns < 1e12) {
        while ((long long)(num_offsets + 1) * (num_offsets + 1) * (num_offsets + 1) * ops_per_offset <= max_ops && num_offsets < 8) {
            num_offsets++;
        }
    }
    if (num_offsets < 1) num_offsets = 1;
    
    vector<Point> best_centers;
    double offset_step = S / num_offsets;
    
    for (int ox = 0; ox < num_offsets; ox++) {
        for (int oy = 0; oy < num_offsets; oy++) {
            for (int oz = 0; oz < num_offsets; oz++) {
                double dx = ox * offset_step;
                double dy = oy * offset_step;
                double dz = oz * offset_step;
                
                vector<Point> current_centers;
                
                int num_top = top_K.size();
                int num_bot = bot_K.size();
                int num_vrt = vrt_K.size();
                
                for (long long i = min_i; i <= max_i; i++) {
                    double X = i * S + dx;
                    for (long long j = min_j; j <= max_j; j++) {
                        double Y = j * S + dy;
                        
                        bool valid_xy = true;
                        for (int f = 0; f < num_vrt; f++) {
                            if (vrt_K[f] - vrt_Nx[f] * X - vrt_Ny[f] * Y < 0) {
                                valid_xy = false;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (!valid_xy) continue;
                        
                        double z_max = 1e18;
                        for (int f = 0; f < num_top; f++) {
                            double z = (top_K[f] - top_Nx[f] * X - top_Ny[f] * Y) * top_Nz_inv[f];
                            if (z < z_max) z_max = z;
                        }
                        
                        double z_min = -1e18;
                        for (int f = 0; f < num_bot; f++) {
                            double z = (bot_K[f] - bot_Nx[f] * X - bot_Ny[f] * Y) * bot_Nz_inv[f];
                            if (z > z_min) z_min = z;
                        }
                        
                        if (z_min < Zmin - 2*S) z_min = Zmin - 2*S;
                        if (z_max > Zmax + 2*S) z_max = Zmax + 2*S;
                        
                        if (z_min > z_max) continue;
                        
                        long long k_start = ceil((z_min - dz) / S - 1e-9);
                        long long k_end = floor((z_max - dz) / S + 1e-9);
                        
                        for (long long k = k_start; k <= k_end; k++) {
                            if (abs(i + j + k) % 2 == 0) {
                                current_centers.push_back(Point(X, Y, k * S + dz));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                if (current_centers.size() > best_centers.size()) {
                    best_centers = current_centers;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << best_centers.size() << "\n";
    cout << fixed << setprecision(6);
    for (const auto& p : best_centers) {
        cout << p.x << " " << p.y << " " << p.z << " 0 0 0\n";
    }
    
    return 0;
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

struct State {
    w: usize,
    h: usize,
    chunks_per_row: usize,
    require_cycle: bool,
    u: Vec<u64>,
    visited: Vec<u64>,
    cnt: [usize; 2],
    degree: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
    deg_count: [usize; 5],
    unvisited_start_neighbors: usize,
    start_neighbors: Vec<Vec<bool>>,
    adj: Vec<Vec<Vec<(usize, usize)>>>,
}

impl State {
    #[inline(always)]
    fn bit_idx(&self, x: usize, y: usize) -> (usize, u64) {
        (y * self.chunks_per_row + (x / 64), 1 << (x % 64))
    }
    
    #[inline(always)]
    fn is_u_set(&self, x: usize, y: usize) -> bool {
        let (idx, mask) = self.bit_idx(x, y);
        (self.u[idx] & mask) != 0
    }
    
    #[inline(always)]
    fn clear_u(&mut self, x: usize, y: usize) {
        let (idx, mask) = self.bit_idx(x, y);
        self.u[idx] &= !mask;
    }
    
    #[inline(always)]
    fn set_u(&mut self, x: usize, y: usize) {
        let (idx, mask) = self.bit_idx(x, y);
        self.u[idx] |= mask;
    }

    fn do_move(&mut self, x: usize, y: usize) {
        self.clear_u(x, y);
        let c = (x + y) % 2;
        self.cnt[c] -= 1;
        let d = self.degree[x][y] as usize;
        self.deg_count[d] -= 1;
        
        if self.require_cycle && self.start_neighbors[x][y] {
            self.unvisited_start_neighbors -= 1;
        }
        
        for i in 0..self.adj[x][y].len() {
            let (nx, ny) = self.adj[x][y][i];
            if self.is_u_set(nx, ny) {
                let nd = self.degree[nx][ny] as usize;
                self.deg_count[nd] -= 1;
                self.degree[nx][ny] -= 1;
                self.deg_count[nd - 1] += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    fn undo_move(&mut self, x: usize, y: usize) {
        for i in 0..self.adj[x][y].len() {
            let (nx, ny) = self.adj[x][y][i];
            if self.is_u_set(nx, ny) {
                let nd = self.degree[nx][ny] as usize;
                self.deg_count[nd] -= 1;
                self.degree[nx][ny] += 1;
                self.deg_count[nd + 1] += 1;
            }
        }
        
        let d = self.degree[x][y] as usize;
        self.deg_count[d] += 1;
        
        if self.require_cycle && self.start_neighbors[x][y] {
            self.unvisited_start_neighbors += 1;
        }
        
        let c = (x + y) % 2;
        self.cnt[c] += 1;
        self.set_u(x, y);
    }
    
    fn is_connected(&mut self) -> bool {
        let mut start_idx = usize::MAX;
        for i in 0..self.u.len() {
            if self.u[i] != 0 {
                start_idx = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        if start_idx == usize::MAX { return true; }
        
        self.visited.fill(0);
        self.visited[start_idx] = self.u[start_idx] & !(self.u[start_idx] - 1);
        
        let mut changed = true;
        let chunks = self.chunks_per_row;
        
        while changed {
            changed = false;
            
            for y in 0..self.h {
                for c in 0..chunks {
                    let idx = y * chunks + c;
                    let mut v = self.visited[idx];
                    let orig = v;
                    
                    let mut left_shifted = v << 1;
                    if c > 0 {
                        left_shifted |= self.visited[idx - 1] >> 63;
                    }
                    
                    let mut right_shifted = v >> 1;
                    if c + 1 < chunks {
                        right_shifted |= self.visited[idx + 1] << 63;
                    }
                    
                    v |= left_shifted | right_shifted;
                    if y > 0 { v |= self.visited[idx - chunks]; }
                    if y + 1 < self.h { v |= self.visited[idx + chunks]; }
                    
                    v &= self.u[idx];
                    if v != orig {
                        self.visited[idx] = v;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for y in (0..self.h).rev() {
                for c in (0..chunks).rev() {
                    let idx = y * chunks + c;
                    let mut v = self.visited[idx];
                    let orig = v;
                    
                    let mut left_shifted = v << 1;
                    if c > 0 {
                        left_shifted |= self.visited[idx - 1] >> 63;
                    }
                    
                    let mut right_shifted = v >> 1;
                    if c + 1 < chunks {
                        right_shifted |= self.visited[idx + 1] << 63;
                    }
                    
                    v |= left_shifted | right_shifted;
                    if y > 0 { v |= self.visited[idx - chunks]; }
                    if y + 1 < self.h { v |= self.visited[idx + chunks]; }
                    
                    v &= self.u[idx];
                    if v != orig {
                        self.visited[idx] = v;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for i in 0..self.u.len() {
            if self.visited[i] != self.u[i] { return false; }
        }
        true
    }

    fn solve(&mut self, cur_x: usize, cur_y: usize, path: &mut Vec<(usize, usize)>) -> bool {
        let u_size = self.cnt[0] + self.cnt[1];
        
        if u_size == 0 {
            if self.require_cycle {
                return self.start_neighbors[cur_x][cur_y];
            } else {
                return true;
            }
        }
        
        if self.require_cycle && self.unvisited_start_neighbors == 0 {
            return false;
        }
        
        let c = (cur_x + cur_y) % 2;
        let expected_diff = (u_size % 2) as i32;
        let actual_diff = self.cnt[1 - c] as i32 - self.cnt[c] as i32;
        if actual_diff != expected_diff {
            return false;
        }
        
        if u_size > 1 && self.deg_count[0] > 0 {
            return false;
        }
        
        if self.deg_count[1] > 2 {
            return false;
        }
        
        if !self.is_connected() {
            return false;
        }
        
        let mut neighbors = [(0, 0, 0); 4];
        let mut n_len = 0;
        
        for i in 0..self.adj[cur_x][cur_y].len() {
            let (nx, ny) = self.adj[cur_x][cur_y][i];
            if self.is_u_set(nx, ny) {
                neighbors[n_len] = (nx, ny, self.degree[nx][ny]);
                n_len += 1;
            }
        }
        
        let slice = &mut neighbors[..n_len];
        slice.sort_unstable_by_key(|k| k.2);
        
        for i in 0..n_len {
            let (nx, ny, _) = slice[i];
            self.do_move(nx, ny);
            path.push((nx, ny));
            
            if self.solve(nx, ny, path) {
                return true;
            }
            
            path.pop();
            self.undo_move(nx, ny);
        }
        
        false
    }
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines().filter_map(Result::ok);
    
    let first_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(l) => l,
        None => return,
    };
    
    let parts: Vec<usize> = first_line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
    if parts.len() < 4 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    
    let mut w = parts[0];
    let mut h = parts[1];
    let obs_count = parts[2];
    let require_cycle = parts[3] != 0;
    
    let transposed = w > h;
    if transposed {
        std::mem::swap(&mut w, &mut h);
    }
    
    let mut obstacles = vec![vec![false; h]; w];
    for _ in 0..obs_count {
        if let Some(line) = lines.next() {
            let mut parts = line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse::<usize>().unwrap());
            let mut x = parts.next().unwrap();
            let mut y = parts.next().unwrap();
            if transposed {
                std::mem::swap(&mut x, &mut y);
            }
            obstacles[x][y] = true;
        }
    }
    
    if obstacles[0][0] {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let chunks_per_row = (w + 63) / 64;
    let mut state = State {
        w,
        h,
        chunks_per_row,
        require_cycle,
        u: vec![0; h * chunks_per_row],
        visited: vec![0; h * chunks_per_row],
        cnt: [0; 2],
        degree: vec![vec![0; h]; w],
        deg_count: [0; 5],
        unvisited_start_neighbors: 0,
        start_neighbors: vec![vec![false; h]; w],
        adj: vec![vec![Vec::new(); h]; w],
    };
    
    let mut total_cells = 0;
    for x in 0..w {
        for y in 0..h {
            if obstacles[x][y] { continue; }
            
            state.set_u(x, y);
            let c = (x + y) % 2;
            state.cnt[c] += 1;
            total_cells += 1;
            
            let mut nbors = Vec::with_capacity(4);
            if x > 0 && !obstacles[x-1][y] { nbors.push((x-1, y)); }
            if x + 1 < w && !obstacles[x+1][y] { nbors.push((x+1, y)); }
            if y > 0 && !obstacles[x][y-1] { nbors.push((x, y-1)); }
            if y + 1 < h && !obstacles[x][y+1] { nbors.push((x, y+1)); }
            
            state.degree[x][y] = nbors.len() as u8;
            state.deg_count[nbors.len()] += 1;
            state.adj[x][y] = nbors;
            
            if (x == 1 && y == 0) || (x == 0 && y == 1) {
                state.start_neighbors[x][y] = true;
                state.unvisited_start_neighbors += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if require_cycle && total_cells % 2 != 0 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    
    let expected_b = total_cells / 2 + total_cells % 2;
    let expected_w = total_cells / 2;
    if state.cnt[0] != expected_b || state.cnt[1] != expected_w {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    
    let mut path = Vec::with_capacity(total_cells);
    path.push((0, 0));
    state.do_move(0, 0);
    
    if state.solve(0, 0, &mut path) {
        println!("{}", path.len());
        for &(x, y) in &path {
            if transposed {
                println!("{} {}", y, x);
            } else {
                println!("{} {}", x, y);
            }
        }
    } else {
        println!("0");
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;

namespace OrbitalTSP
{
    public struct Vector3D
    {
        public double X, Y, Z;
        public Vector3D(double x, double y, double z) { X = x; Y = y; Z = z; }
        public static Vector3D operator -(Vector3D a, Vector3D b) => new Vector3D(a.X - b.X, a.Y - b.Y, a.Z - b.Z);
        public static Vector3D operator +(Vector3D a, Vector3D b) => new Vector3D(a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y, a.Z + b.Z);
        public static Vector3D operator *(Vector3D a, double d) => new Vector3D(a.X * d, a.Y * d, a.Z * d);
        public static Vector3D operator /(Vector3D a, double d) => new Vector3D(a.X / d, a.Y / d, a.Z / d);
        public static Vector3D Cross(Vector3D a, Vector3D b) => new Vector3D(a.Y * b.Z - a.Z * b.Y, a.Z * b.X - a.X * b.Z, a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X);
        public double Dot(Vector3D b) => X * b.X + Y * b.Y + Z * b.Z;
        public double Magnitude() => Math.Sqrt(X * X + Y * Y + Z * Z);
    }

    class Orbit
    {
        public Vector3D r, v, h, e;
        public double a, eps;
        public Orbit(Vector3D r, Vector3D v, double mu)
        {
            this.r = r; this.v = v;
            h = Vector3D.Cross(r, v);
            eps = v.Magnitude() * v.Magnitude() / 2.0 - mu / r.Magnitude();
            eps = Math.Min(-1e-9, eps); // Ensure bound orbit for heuristic approximation
            a = -mu / (2.0 * eps);
            e = Vector3D.Cross(v, h) / mu - r / r.Magnitude();
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        static double ComputeCost(Orbit o1, Orbit o2, double mu)
        {
            double v1 = Math.Sqrt(mu / o1.a);
            double v2 = Math.Sqrt(mu / o2.a);
            double atx = (o1.a + o2.a) / 2.0;
            double vtx1 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(0, mu * (2.0 / o1.a - 1.0 / atx)));
            double vtx2 = Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(0, mu * (2.0 / o2.a - 1.0 / atx)));

            double h1Mag = o1.h.Magnitude();
            double h2Mag = o2.h.Magnitude();
            double cosTheta = (h1Mag > 1e-9 && h2Mag > 1e-9) ? o1.h.Dot(o2.h) / (h1Mag * h2Mag) : 1.0;
            double theta = Math.Acos(Math.Max(-1.0, Math.Min(1.0, cosTheta)));

            double dv_combined, dv_other;
            if (o1.a > o2.a)
            {
                dv_combined = Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(0, vtx1 * vtx1 + v1 * v1 - 2 * vtx1 * v1 * Math.Cos(theta)));
                dv_other = Math.Abs(vtx2 - v2);
            }
            else
            {
                dv_combined = Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(0, vtx2 * vtx2 + v2 * v2 - 2 * vtx2 * v2 * Math.Cos(theta)));
                dv_other = Math.Abs(vtx1 - v1);
            }

            double dv = dv_combined + dv_other;
            double de = (o1.e - o2.e).Magnitude();
            double ecc_penalty = Math.Max(v1, v2) * de;

            return dv + ecc_penalty;
        }

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            string firstLine = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(firstLine)) return;
            string[] parts1 = firstLine.Split(new char[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            int N = int.Parse(parts1[0]);
            double mu = double.Parse(parts1[1], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

            double[] ReadVector()
            {
                string line = Console.ReadLine();
                string[] parts = line.Split(new char[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                return parts.Select(p => double.Parse(p, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)).ToArray();
            }

            double[] startParts = ReadVector();
            Orbit startOrbit = new Orbit(
                new Vector3D(startParts[0], startParts[1], startParts[2]),
                new Vector3D(startParts[3], startParts[4], startParts[5]),
                mu
            );

            Orbit[] stations = new Orbit[N];
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                double[] s = ReadVector();
                stations[i] = new Orbit(
                    new Vector3D(s[0], s[1], s[2]),
                    new Vector3D(s[3], s[4], s[5]),
                    mu
                );
            }

            int numNodes = N + 1;
            double[,] dist = new double[numNodes, numNodes];
            Orbit[] allOrbits = new Orbit[numNodes];
            allOrbits[0] = startOrbit;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) allOrbits[i + 1] = stations[i];

            for (int i = 0; i < numNodes; i++)
            {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < numNodes; j++)
                {
                    double c = ComputeCost(allOrbits[i], allOrbits[j], mu);
                    dist[i, j] = c;
                    dist[j, i] = c;
                }
            }

            int[] bestTour = null;
            double bestCost = double.MaxValue;
            Random rnd = new Random(42);

            Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();

            int iterations = 0;
            // Adaptive time limit: 4.5 seconds to guarantee we finish well within 5 seconds.
            while (sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < 4500 && iterations < 200000)
            {
                iterations++;
                int[] tour = new int[numNodes];
                tour[0] = 0;
                List<int> unvisited = new List<int>(N);
                for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) unvisited.Add(i);

                int current = 0;
                for (int i = 1; i < numNodes; i++)
                {
                    int best1 = -1, best2 = -1, best3 = -1;
                    double d1 = double.MaxValue, d2 = double.MaxValue, d3 = double.MaxValue;

                    foreach (int n in unvisited)
                    {
                        double d = dist[current, n];
                        if (d < d1)
                        {
                            d3 = d2; best3 = best2;
                            d2 = d1; best2 = best1;
                            d1 = d; best1 = n;
                        }
                        else if (d < d2)
                        {
                            d3 = d2; best3 = best2;
                            d2 = d; best2 = n;
                        }
                        else if (d < d3)
                        {
                            d3 = d; best3 = n;
                        }
                    }

                    List<int> candidates = new List<int>();
                    if (best1 != -1) candidates.Add(best1);
                    if (best2 != -1) candidates.Add(best2);
                    if (best3 != -1) candidates.Add(best3);

                    int next = candidates[rnd.Next(candidates.Count)];
                    tour[i] = next;
                    unvisited.Remove(next);
                    current = next;
                }

                double currentCost = Evaluate(tour, dist);

                bool improved = true;
                while (improved)
                {
                    improved = false;
                    for (int i = 1; i < numNodes - 1; i++)
                    {
                        for (int j = i + 1; j < numNodes; j++)
                        {
                            double oldEdgeCost = dist[tour[i - 1], tour[i]];
                            if (j < numNodes - 1)
                                oldEdgeCost += dist[tour[j], tour[j + 1]];

                            double newEdgeCost = dist[tour[i - 1], tour[j]];
                            if (j < numNodes - 1)
                                newEdgeCost += dist[tour[i], tour[j + 1]];

                            if (newEdgeCost < oldEdgeCost - 1e-9)
                            {
                                Array.Reverse(tour, i, j - i + 1);
                                currentCost = currentCost - oldEdgeCost + newEdgeCost;
                                improved = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (currentCost < bestCost)
                {
                    bestCost = currentCost;
                    bestTour = (int[])tour.Clone();
                }
            }

            int[] resultIndices = new int[N];
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                resultIndices[i] = bestTour[i + 1] - 1;
            }

            Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", resultIndices));
        }

        static double Evaluate(int[] tour, double[,] dist)
        {
            double cost = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < tour.Length - 1; i++)
            {
                cost += dist[tour[i], tour[i + 1]];
            }
            return cost;
        }
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are implementing a CSG (Constructive Solid Geometry) Union operation in C++.

You must write a C++ solver that can handle ANY mesh complexity from trivial (6 vertex unit cubes) to
ludicrous scale (millions of vertices). The same program must work efficiently across ALL scales.

**Input format (stdin):**
Line 1: VA FA VB FB (vertex/face counts for mesh A and B)
Next VA lines: x y z (mesh A vertices)
Next FA lines: a b c (mesh A faces, 0-indexed)
Next VB lines: x y z (mesh B vertices)
Next FB lines: a b c (mesh B faces)

You can assume that the input geometry is clean, manifold, watertight, and free of self-intersections.

**Output format (stdout):**
Line 1: V F (vertex and face counts for union mesh)
Next V lines: x y z

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <random>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

struct Vec3 {
    double x, y, z;
    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& o) const { return {x+o.x, y+o.y, z+o.z}; }
    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& o) const { return {x-o.x, y-o.y, z-o.z}; }
    Vec3 operator*(double s) const { return {x*s, y*s, z*s}; }
    Vec3 operator/(double s) const { return {x/s, y/s, z/s}; }
};

double dot(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) { return a.x*b.x + a.y*b.y + a.z*b.z; }
Vec3 cross(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    return {a.y*b.z - a.z*b.y, a.z*b.x - a.x*b.z, a.x*b.y - a.y*b.x};
}
double length_squared(const Vec3& v) { return dot(v, v); }
double length(const Vec3& v) { return sqrt(length_squared(v)); }
Vec3 normalize(const Vec3& v) { double l = length(v); return l > 0 ? v/l : v; }

struct Triangle { Vec3 v0, v1, v2; };

struct AABB {
    Vec3 min_p, max_p;
    AABB() : min_p{1e30, 1e30, 1e30}, max_p{-1e30, -1e30, -1e30} {}
    void expand(const Vec3& p) {
        min_p.x = min(min_p.x, p.x); min_p.y = min(min_p.y, p.y); min_p.z = min(min_p.z, p.z);
        max_p.x = max(max_p.x, p.x); max_p.y = max(max_p.y, p.y); max_p.z = max(max_p.z, p.z);
    }
    bool intersects(const AABB& b) const {
        if (max_p.x < b.min_p.x || min_p.x > b.max_p.x) return false;
        if (max_p.y < b.min_p.y || min_p.y > b.max_p.y) return false;
        if (max_p.z < b.min_p.z || min_p.z > b.max_p.z) return false;
        return true;
    }
    bool intersect_ray(const Vec3& ro, const Vec3& rd_inv) const {
        double t1 = (min_p.x - ro.x) * rd_inv.x;
        double t2 = (max_p.x - ro.x) * rd_inv.x;
        double tmin = min(t1, t2); double tmax = max(t1, t2);
        
        t1 = (min_p.y - ro.y) * rd_inv.y;
        t2 = (max_p.y - ro.y) * rd_inv.y;
        tmin = max(tmin, min(t1, t2)); tmax = min(tmax, max(t1, t2));
        
        t1 = (min_p.z - ro.z) * rd_inv.z;
        t2 = (max_p.z - ro.z) * rd_inv.z;
        tmin = max(tmin, min(t1, t2)); tmax = min(tmax, max(t1, t2));
        
        return tmax >= max(0.0, tmin);
    }
};

struct Mesh {
    vector<Vec3> vertices;
    vector<int> indices;
    Triangle get_triangle(int idx) const {
        return {vertices[indices[idx*3]], vertices[indices[idx*3+1]], vertices[indices[idx*3+2]]};
    }
    AABB get_aabb(int idx) const {
        AABB b; Triangle t = get_triangle(idx);
        b.expand(t.v0); b.expand(t.v1); b.expand(t.v2);
        return b;
    }
};

struct BVHNode {
    AABB aabb;
    int left, right;
    int start, end;
    bool is_leaf;
};

struct BVH {
    vector<BVHNode> nodes;
    vector<int> tri_indices;
    const Mesh* mesh;

    void build(const Mesh& m) {
        mesh = &m;
        int num_tris = m.indices.size() / 3;
        tri_indices.resize(num_tris);
        for(int i=0; i<num_tris; ++i) tri_indices[i] = i;
        nodes.reserve(num_tris * 2);
        build_recursive(0, num_tris);
    }

    int build_recursive(int start, int end) {
        BVHNode node;
        node.start = start; node.end = end;
        
        for(int i=start; i<end; ++i) {
            Triangle t = mesh->get_triangle(tri_indices[i]);
            node.aabb.expand(t.v0); node.aabb.expand(t.v1); node.aabb.expand(t.v2);
        }

        if (end - start <= 4) {
            node.is_leaf = true; node.left = node.right = -1;
            nodes.push_back(node);
            return nodes.size() - 1;
        }

        node.is_leaf = false;
        Vec3 size = node.aabb.max_p - node.aabb.min_p;
        int axis = 0;
        if (size.y > size.x && size.y > size.z) axis = 1;
        if (size.z > size.x && size.z > size.y) axis = 2;

        auto comp = [&](int a, int b) {
            Triangle ta = mesh->get_triangle(a); Triangle tb = mesh->get_triangle(b);
            Vec3 ca = ta.v0 + ta.v1 + ta.v2; Vec3 cb = tb.v0 + tb.v1 + tb.v2;
            if (axis == 0) return ca.x < cb.x;
            if (axis == 1) return ca.y < cb.y;
            return ca.z < cb.z;
        };

        int mid = start + (end - start) / 2;
        nth_element(tri_indices.begin() + start, tri_indices.begin() + mid, tri_indices.begin() + end, comp);

        int curr_idx = nodes.size();
        nodes.push_back(node);
        int left = build_recursive(start, mid);
        int right = build_recursive(mid, end);
        nodes[curr_idx].left = left; nodes[curr_idx].right = right;
        return curr_idx;
    }

    void query_aabb(int node_idx, const AABB& box, vector<int>& out) const {
        if (!nodes[node_idx].aabb.intersects(box)) return;
        if (nodes[node_idx].is_leaf) {
            for(int i=nodes[node_idx].start; i<nodes[node_idx].end; ++i) out.push_back(tri_indices[i]);
        } else {
            query_aabb(nodes[node_idx].left, box, out);
            query_aabb(nodes[node_idx].right, box, out);
        }
    }
};

bool sat_test(const Vec3& axis, const Vec3 p1[3], const Vec3 p2[3]) {
    double l2 = length_squared(axis);
    if (l2 < 1e-14) return false;
    double l = sqrt(l2);
    Vec3 naxis = axis / l;
    double min1 = 1e30, max1 = -1e30, min2 = 1e30, max2 = -1e30;
    for(int i=0; i<3; ++i) {
        double p = dot(p1[i], naxis);
        if (p < min1) min1 = p; if (p > max1) max1 = p;
        double q = dot(p2[i], naxis);
        if (q < min2) min2 = q; if (q > max2) max2 = q;
    }
    return (max1 < min2 - 1e-7 || max2 < min1 - 1e-7);
}

bool tri_tri_intersect(const Triangle& t1, const Triangle& t2) {
    Vec3 p1[3] = {t1.v0, t1.v1, t1.v2};
    Vec3 p2[3] = {t2.v0, t2.v1, t2.v2};
    Vec3 e1[3] = {p1[1]-p1[0], p1[2]-p1[1], p1[0]-p1[2]};
    Vec3 e2[3] = {p2[1]-p2[0], p2[2]-p2[1], p2[0]-p2[2]};
    Vec3 n1 = cross(e1[0], e1[1]);
    Vec3 n2 = cross(e2[0], e2[1]);
    
    if (sat_test(n1, p1, p2)) return false;
    if (sat_test(n2, p1, p2)) return false;
    for(int i=0; i<3; ++i) {
        if (sat_test(cross(e1[i], n1), p1, p2)) return false;
        if (sat_test(cross(e2[i], n2), p1, p2)) return false;
        for(int j=0; j<3; ++j) {
            if (sat_test(cross(e1[i], e2[j]), p1, p2)) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

struct Plane {
    Vec3 n; double d;
    Plane(Vec3 normal, double dist) {
        double l = length(normal);
        n = normal / l; d = dist / l;
    }
};

struct Polygon { vector<Vec3> vertices; };

void clean_polygon(Polygon& p) {
    if (p.vertices.empty()) return;
    vector<Vec3> clean;
    clean.push_back(p.vertices[0]);
    for(size_t i=1; i<p.vertices.size(); ++i) {
        if (length_squared(p.vertices[i] - clean.back()) > 1e-12) clean.push_back(p.vertices[i]);
    }
    if (clean.size() > 1 && length_squared(clean.front() - clean.back()) <= 1e-12) clean.pop_back();
    p.vertices = clean;
}

void split_polygon(const Polygon& poly, const Plane& plane, Polygon& front, Polygon& back) {
    int n = poly.vertices.size();
    vector<double> dists(n);
    for(int i=0; i<n; ++i) dists[i] = dot(poly.vertices[i], plane.n) - plane.d;
    
    for(int i=0; i<n; ++i) {
        int j = (i + 1) % n;
        double d1 = dists[i], d2 = dists[j];
        
        if (d1 >= -1e-9) front.vertices.push_back(poly.vertices[i]);
        if (d1 <= 1e-9) back.vertices.push_back(poly.vertices[i]);
        
        if ((d1 > 1e-9 && d2 < -1e-9) || (d1 < -1e-9 && d2 > 1e-9)) {
            double t = d1 / (d1 - d2);
            Vec3 p = poly.vertices[i] + (poly.vertices[j] - poly.vertices[i]) * t;
            front.vertices.push_back(p);
            back.vertices.push_back(p);
        }
    }
    clean_polygon(front); clean_polygon(back);
}

bool plane_intersects_polygon(const Polygon& poly, const Plane& plane) {
    bool has_front = false, has_back = false;
    for(const Vec3& v : poly.vertices) {
        double d = dot(v, plane.n) - plane.d;
        if (d > 1e-9) has_front = true;
        if (d < -1e-9) has_back = true;
        if (has_front && has_back) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool ray_tri(const Vec3& ro, const Vec3& rd, const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {
    Vec3 edge1 = v1 - v0, edge2 = v2 - v0;
    Vec3 h = cross(rd, edge2);
    double a = dot(edge1, h);
    if (a > -1e-8 && a < 1e-8) return false;
    double f = 1.0 / a;
    Vec3 s = ro - v0;
    double u = f * dot(s, h);
    if (u < 0.0 || u > 1.0) return false;
    Vec3 q = cross(s, edge1);
    double v = f * dot(rd, q);
    if (v < 0.0 || u + v > 1.0) return false;
    double t = f * dot(edge2, q);
    return t > 1e-8;
}

Vec3 random_dir() {
    static mt19937 g(12345);
    uniform_real_distribution<double> dist(-1.0, 1.0);
    while (true) {
        Vec3 v = {dist(g), dist(g), dist(g)};
        double l2 = length_squared(v);
        if (l2 > 0.1 && l2 <= 1.0) return v / sqrt(l2);
    }
}

bool is_inside(const BVH& bvh, const Mesh& mesh, const Vec3& c) {
    Vec3 dir = random_dir();
    Vec3 rd_inv = {1.0/(abs(dir.x)<1e-9?1e-9:dir.x), 1.0/(abs(dir.y)<1e-9?1e-9:dir.y), 1.0/(abs(dir.z)<1e-9?1e-9:dir.z)};
    int count = 0;
    
    vector<int> stack; stack.push_back(0);
    while (!stack.empty()) {
        int node = stack.back(); stack.pop_back();
        if (!bvh.nodes[node].aabb.intersect_ray(c, rd_inv)) continue;
        if (bvh.nodes[node].is_leaf) {
            for(int i=bvh.nodes[node].start; i<bvh.nodes[node].end; ++i) {
                Triangle tri = mesh.get_triangle(bvh.tri_indices[i]);
                if (ray_tri(c, dir, tri.v0, tri.v1, tri.v2)) count++;
            }
        } else {
            stack.push_back(bvh.nodes[node].left);
            stack.push_back(bvh.nodes[node].right);
        }
    }
    return (count % 2) != 0;
}

struct GridCell {
    int cx, cy, cz, index;
    bool operator<(const GridCell& o) const {
        if (cx != o.cx) return cx < o.cx;
        if (cy != o.cy) return cy < o.cy;
        return cz < o.cz;
    }
};

bool point_on_segment(const Vec3& p, const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) {
    Vec3 ab = b - a;
    double l2 = length_squared(ab);
    if (l2 < 1e-14) return false;
    double t = dot(p - a, ab) / l2;
    if (t <= 1e-5 || t >= 1.0 - 1e-5) return false;
    Vec3 proj = a + ab * t;
    return length_squared(p - proj) < 1e-12;
}

struct TriData {
    int i0, i1, i2, c0, c1, c2;
    bool operator<(const TriData& o) const {
        if (c0 != o.c0) return c0 < o.c0;
        if (c1 != o.c1) return c1 < o.c1;
        return c2 < o.c2;
    }
    bool operator==(const TriData& o) const { return c0 == o.c0 && c1 == o.c1 && c2 == o.c2; }
};

TriData make_tridata(int i0, int i1, int i2) {
    TriData d; d.i0 = i0; d.i1 = i1; d.i2 = i2;
    if (i0 < i1 && i0 < i2) { d.c0 = i0; d.c1 = i1; d.c2 = i2; }
    else if (i1 < i0 && i1 < i2) { d.c0 = i1; d.c1 = i2; d.c2 = i0; }
    else { d.c0 = i2; d.c1 = i0; d.c2 = i1; }
    return d;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    size_t VA, FA, VB, FB;
    if (!(cin >> VA >> FA >> VB >> FB)) return 0;

    Mesh meshA, meshB;
    meshA.vertices.resize(VA);
    for(size_t i=0; i<VA; ++i) cin >> meshA.vertices[i].x >> meshA.vertices[i].y >> meshA.vertices[i].z;
    meshA.indices.resize(FA * 3);
    for(size_t i=0; i<FA*3; ++i) cin >> meshA.indices[i];

    meshB.vertices.resize(VB);
    for(size_t i=0; i<VB; ++i) cin >> meshB.vertices[i].x >> meshB.vertices[i].y >> meshB.vertices[i].z;
    meshB.indices.resize(FB * 3);
    for(size_t i=0; i<FB*3; ++i) cin >> meshB.indices[i];

    BVH bvhA, bvhB;
    bvhA.build(meshA); bvhB.build(meshB);

    mt19937 g_rand(42);
    vector<Polygon> all_polys;

    auto process_mesh = [&](const Mesh& mesh1, const BVH& b1, const Mesh& mesh2, const BVH& b2, bool is_A) {
        for(size_t i=0; i<mesh1.indices.size()/3; ++i) {
            Triangle t1 = mesh1.get_triangle(i);
            Vec3 n1 = normalize(cross(t1.v1 - t1.v0, t1.v2 - t1.v0));
            AABB box = mesh1.get_aabb(i);
            
            vector<int> cands;
            b2.query_aabb(0, box, cands);
            
            vector<Plane> split_planes;
            for(int idx2 : cands) {
                Triangle t2 = mesh2.get_triangle(idx2);
                if (tri_tri_intersect(t1, t2)) {
                    Vec3 n2 = normalize(cross(t2.v1 - t2.v0, t2.v2 - t2.v0));
                    if (abs(dot(n1, n2)) > 1.0 - 1e-6) {
                        Vec3 d0 = normalize(t2.v1 - t2.v0);
                        Vec3 d1 = normalize(t2.v2 - t2.v1);
                        Vec3 d2 = normalize(t2.v0 - t2.v2);
                        split_planes.push_back(Plane(cross(d0, n2), dot(cross(d0, n2), t2.v0)));
                        split_planes.push_back(Plane(cross(d1, n2), dot(cross(d1, n2), t2.v1)));
                        split_planes.push_back(Plane(cross(d2, n2), dot(cross(d2, n2), t2.v2)));
                    } else {
                        split_planes.push_back(Plane(n2, dot(n2, t2.v0)));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            shuffle(split_planes.begin(), split_planes.end(), g_rand);
            vector<Polygon> fragments = { Polygon{{t1.v0, t1.v1, t1.v2}} };
            
            for(const auto& pl : split_planes) {
                vector<Polygon> next_frag;
                for(const auto& poly : fragments) {
                    if (!plane_intersects_polygon(poly, pl)) {
                        next_frag.push_back(poly);
                        continue;
                    }
                    Polygon front, back;
                    split_polygon(poly, pl, front, back);
                    if (front.vertices.size() >= 3) next_frag.push_back(front);
                    if (back.vertices.size() >= 3) next_frag.push_back(back);
                }
                fragments = next_frag;
            }
            
            for(const auto& poly : fragments) {
                Vec3 c = {0,0,0};
                for(const auto& v : poly.vertices) c = c + v;
                c = c / poly.vertices.size();
                Vec3 c_test = c + n1 * 1e-5;
                if (!is_inside(b2, mesh2, c_test)) all_polys.push_back(poly);
            }
        }
    };

    process_mesh(meshA, bvhA, meshB, bvhB, true);
    process_mesh(meshB, bvhB, meshA, bvhA, false);

    vector<Vec3> raw_v;
    for(const auto& p : all_polys) for(const auto& v : p.vertices) raw_v.push_back(v);

    double eps = 1e-5;
    vector<GridCell> grid(raw_v.size());
    for(int i=0; i<raw_v.size(); ++i) {
        grid[i] = {(int)floor(raw_v[i].x/eps), (int)floor(raw_v[i].y/eps), (int)floor(raw_v[i].z/eps), i};
    }
    sort(grid.begin(), grid.end());

    vector<Vec3> out_v;
    vector<int> remap(raw_v.size(), -1);

    for(int i=0; i<grid.size(); ++i) {
        int orig_idx = grid[i].index;
        if (remap[orig_idx] != -1) continue;
        
        int new_idx = out_v.size();
        out_v.push_back(raw_v[orig_idx]);
        remap[orig_idx] = new_idx;
        
        int cx = grid[i].cx, cy = grid[i].cy, cz = grid[i].cz;
        for(int dx=-1; dx<=1; ++dx) {
            for(int dy=-1; dy<=1; ++dy) {
                for(int dz=-1; dz<=1; ++dz) {
                    GridCell dummy{cx+dx, cy+dy, cz+dz, 0};
                    auto it = lower_bound(grid.begin(), grid.end(), dummy);
                    while(it != grid.end() && it->cx == cx+dx && it->cy == cy+dy && it->cz == cz+dz) {
                        if (remap[it->index] == -1) {
                            if (length_squared(raw_v[it->index] - raw_v[orig_idx]) < eps*eps) {
                                remap[it->index] = new_idx;
                            }
                        }
                        it++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    struct PolyIdx { vector<int> idxs; };
    vector<PolyIdx> all_pidxs;
    int raw_idx = 0;
    for(const auto& p : all_polys) {
        PolyIdx pi;
        for(size_t i=0; i<p.vertices.size(); ++i) pi.idxs.push_back(remap[raw_idx++]);
        vector<int> clean;
        for(int idx : pi.idxs) {
            if (clean.empty() || clean.back() != idx) clean.push_back(idx);
        }
        if (clean.size() > 1 && clean.front() == clean.back()) clean.pop_back();
        if (clean.size() >= 3) all_pidxs.push_back({clean});
    }

    vector<GridCell> vgrid(out_v.size());
    for(int i=0; i<out_v.size(); ++i) {
        vgrid[i] = {(int)floor(out_v[i].x/eps), (int)floor(out_v[i].y/eps), (int)floor(out_v[i].z/eps), i};
    }
    sort(vgrid.begin(), vgrid.end());

    for(auto& pi : all_pidxs) {
        vector<int> new_idxs;
        for(size_t i=0; i<pi.idxs.size(); ++i) {
            int a = pi.idxs[i];
            int b = pi.idxs[(i+1)%pi.idxs.size()];
            new_idxs.push_back(a);
            
            Vec3 va = out_v[a], vb = out_v[b];
            Vec3 min_p = {min(va.x, vb.x), min(va.y, vb.y), min(va.z, vb.z)};
            Vec3 max_p = {max(va.x, vb.x), max(va.y, vb.y), max(va.z, vb.z)};
            
            int min_cx = floor(min_p.x/eps)-1, max_cx = floor(max_p.x/eps)+1;
            int min_cy = floor(min_p.y/eps)-1, max_cy = floor(max_p.y/eps)+1;
            int min_cz = floor(min_p.z/eps)-1, max_cz = floor(max_p.z/eps)+1;
            
            vector<pair<double, int>> splits;
            for(int cx=min_cx; cx<=max_cx; ++cx) {
                for(int cy=min_cy; cy<=max_cy; ++cy) {
                    for(int cz=min_cz; cz<=max_cz; ++cz) {
                        GridCell dummy{cx, cy, cz, 0};
                        auto it = lower_bound(vgrid.begin(), vgrid.end(), dummy);
                        while(it != vgrid.end() && it->cx == cx && it->cy == cy && it->cz == cz) {
                            int idx = it->index;
                            if (idx != a && idx != b && point_on_segment(out_v[idx], va, vb)) {
                                double t = dot(out_v[idx] - va, vb - va) / length_squared(vb - va);
                                splits.push_back({t, idx});
                            }
                            it++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            sort(splits.begin(), splits.end());
            for(const auto& sp : splits) {
                if (new_idxs.back() != sp.second) new_idxs.push_back(sp.second);
            }
        }
        pi.idxs = new_idxs;
    }

    vector<TriData> final_tris;
    for(const auto& pi : all_pidxs) {
        for(size_t i=1; i+1<pi.idxs.size(); ++i) {
            int i0 = pi.idxs[0];
            int i1 = pi.idxs[i];
            int i2 = pi.idxs[i+1];
            if (i0 == i1 || i1 == i2 || i2 == i0) continue;
            if (length_squared(cross(out_v[i1]-out_v[i0], out_v[i2]-out_v[i0])) < 1e-12) continue;
            final_tris.push_back(make_tridata(i0, i1, i2));
        }
    }

    sort(final_tris.begin(), final_tris.end());
    vector<TriData> unique_tris;
    for(size_t i=0; i<final_tris.size(); ++i) {
        if (i > 0 && final_tris[i] == final_tris[i-1]) continue;
        unique_tris.push_back(final_tris[i]);
    }

    cout << out_v.size() << " " << unique_tris.size() << "\n";
    cout << fixed << setprecision(6);
    for(const auto& v : out_v) cout << v.x << " " << v.y << " " << v.z << "\n";
    for(const auto& t : unique_tris) cout << t.i0 << " " << t.i1 << " " << t.i2 << "\n";

    return 0;
}
