use std::io::{self, BufRead, Read, Write};
use std::collections::VecDeque;

const UNVISITED: u8 = 0;
const WALL: u8 = 1;
const PARENT_UP: u8 = 2;
const PARENT_RIGHT: u8 = 3;
const PARENT_DOWN: u8 = 4;
const PARENT_LEFT: u8 = 5;
const START: u8 = 6;

const NEXT_UP: u8 = 10;
const NEXT_RIGHT: u8 = 11;
const NEXT_DOWN: u8 = 12;
const NEXT_LEFT: u8 = 13;
const GOAL_MARK: u8 = 14;

struct FastWriter<W: Write> {
    writer: W,
    buf: Vec<u8>,
}

impl<W: Write> FastWriter<W> {
    fn new(writer: W) -> Self {
        Self {
            writer,
            buf: Vec::with_capacity(64 * 1024),
        }
    }

    fn write_u32(&mut self, mut n: u32) {
        if n == 0 {
            self.push(b'0');
            return;
        }
        let mut temp = [0u8; 10];
        let mut len = 0;
        while n > 0 {
            temp[len] = b'0' + (n % 10) as u8;
            n /= 10;
            len += 1;
        }
        for i in (0..len).rev() {
            self.push(temp[i]);
        }
    }

    fn push(&mut self, b: u8) {
        if self.buf.len() == self.buf.capacity() {
            self.flush();
        }
        self.buf.push(b);
    }

    fn flush(&mut self) {
        if !self.buf.is_empty() {
            self.writer.write_all(&self.buf).unwrap();
            self.buf.clear();
        }
    }
}

impl<W: Write> Drop for FastWriter<W> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.flush();
    }
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lock = stdin.lock();

    let mut first_line = String::new();
    if lock.read_line(&mut first_line).is_err() {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    let parts: Vec<u32> = first_line.split_whitespace().filter_map(|s| s.parse().ok()).collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    let h = parts[0] as u32;
    let w = parts[1] as u32;

    if w == 0 || h == 0 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }

    let mut grid = vec![UNVISITED; (w as usize) * (h as usize)];
    let mut start = None;
    let mut goal = None;

    let mut r: u32 = 0;
    let mut c: u32 = 0;

    loop {
        let buffer = lock.fill_buf().unwrap();
        let n = buffer.len();
        if n == 0 { break; }

        let mut consumed = 0;
        for &b in buffer {
            consumed += 1;
            if b == b'\n' {
                c = 0;
                r += 1;
                continue;
            }
            if b == b'\r' {
                continue;
            }
            if r >= h {
                break;
            }

            if c < w {
                let idx = (r as usize) * (w as usize) + (c as usize);
                if b == b'A' {
                    start = Some((c, r));
                } else if b == b'B' {
                    goal = Some((c, r));
                } else if b == b'#' {
                    grid[idx] = WALL;
                }
                c += 1;
            }
        }
        lock.consume(consumed);
        if r >= h { break; }
    }

    let (start_x, start_y) = match start {
        Some(s) => s,
        None => { println!("0"); return; }
    };
    let (goal_x, goal_y) = match goal {
        Some(g) => g,
        None => { println!("0"); return; }
    };

    let mut end_found = start_x == goal_x && start_y == goal_y;
    let goal_idx = (goal_y as usize) * (w as usize) + (goal_x as usize);
    let start_idx = (start_y as usize) * (w as usize) + (start_x as usize);
    grid[start_idx] = START;

    if !end_found {
        let mut q = VecDeque::new();
        q.push_back((start_x, start_y));

        while let Some((x, y)) = q.pop_front() {
            let idx = (y as usize) * (w as usize) + (x as usize);

            // UP
            if y > 0 {
                let nidx = idx - (w as usize);
                if grid[nidx] == UNVISITED {
                    grid[nidx] = PARENT_DOWN;
                    if nidx == goal_idx {
                        end_found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    q.push_back((x, y - 1));
                }
            }
            // RIGHT
            if x + 1 < w {
                let nidx = idx + 1;
                if grid[nidx] == UNVISITED {
                    grid[nidx] = PARENT_LEFT;
                    if nidx == goal_idx {
                        end_found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    q.push_back((x + 1, y));
                }
            }
            // DOWN
            if y + 1 < h {
                let nidx = idx + (w as usize);
                if grid[nidx] == UNVISITED {
                    grid[nidx] = PARENT_UP;
                    if nidx == goal_idx {
                        end_found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    q.push_back((x, y + 1));
                }
            }
            // LEFT
            if x > 0 {
                let nidx = idx - 1;
                if grid[nidx] == UNVISITED {
                    grid[nidx] = PARENT_RIGHT;
                    if nidx == goal_idx {
                        end_found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    q.push_back((x - 1, y));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if end_found {
        let mut len = 0;
        let mut cx = goal_x;
        let mut cy = goal_y;

        let mut prev_dir = GOAL_MARK;

        loop {
            len += 1;
            let idx = (cy as usize) * (w as usize) + (cx as usize);
            let val = grid[idx];

            grid[idx] = prev_dir;

            if val == START {
                break;
            } else if val == PARENT_UP {
                cy -= 1;
                prev_dir = NEXT_DOWN;
            } else if val == PARENT_RIGHT {
                cx += 1;
                prev_dir = NEXT_LEFT;
            } else if val == PARENT_DOWN {
                cy += 1;
                prev_dir = NEXT_UP;
            } else if val == PARENT_LEFT {
                cx -= 1;
                prev_dir = NEXT_RIGHT;
            } else {
                println!("0");
                return;
            }
        }

        let stdout = io::stdout();
        let mut out = FastWriter::new(stdout.lock());
        out.write_u32(len);
        out.push(b'\n');

        let mut cx = start_x;
        let mut cy = start_y;

        loop {
            out.write_u32(cx);
            out.push(b' ');
            out.write_u32(cy);
            out.push(b'\n');

            let idx = (cy as usize) * (w as usize) + (cx as usize);
            let next_dir = grid[idx];

            if next_dir == GOAL_MARK {
                break;
            } else if next_dir == NEXT_UP {
                cy -= 1;
            } else if next_dir == NEXT_RIGHT {
                cx += 1;
            } else if next_dir == NEXT_DOWN {
                cy += 1;
            } else if next_dir == NEXT_LEFT {
                cx -= 1;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
    } else {
        println!("0");
    }
}

Given fixed-length stock material and a shopping list of smaller pieces to cut, use as few stock pieces as possible. Every requested piece must be cut from somewhere, but any leftover material is wasted — so packing the cuts tightly matters.

This is essentially a bin-packing problem and is NP-hard. Subpasses scale from a handful of cuts up to millions, forcing the AI to write code that is both correct and fast. The baseline uses a simple first-fit-decreasing heuristic.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;

class Program {
    static long bestSum = -1;
    static int[] bestPattern;
    static int[] currentPattern;
    static int iterations = 0;
    const int MAX_ITERATIONS = 5000;

    class Pattern {
        public int[] counts;
        public int times;
    }

    struct Cut : IComparable<Cut> {
        public long length;
        public int index;
        public int CompareTo(Cut other) {
            int cmp = other.length.CompareTo(length);
            if (cmp == 0) return index.CompareTo(other.index);
            return cmp;
        }
    }

    static void Main(string[] args) {
        using var stream = Console.OpenStandardInput();
        var scanner = new FastScanner(stream);

        int N = scanner.ReadInt();
        if (N <= 0) {
            Console.WriteLine(0);
            return;
        }
        long stockLength = scanner.ReadLong();

        var cuts = new Cut[N];
        var originalIndices = new Dictionary<long, Stack<int>>();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            long len = scanner.ReadLong();
            cuts[i] = new Cut { length = len, index = i };
            if (!originalIndices.TryGetValue(len, out var stack)) {
                stack = new Stack<int>();
                originalIndices[len] = stack;
            }
            stack.Push(i);
        }

        int m = originalIndices.Count;

        using var writer = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), bufferSize: 65536);

        if (m <= 5000) {
            // Pattern-based greedy algorithm (very strong heuristic / exact for many cases)
            long[] L = originalIndices.Keys.OrderByDescending(x => x).ToArray();
            int[] available = new int[m];
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) available[i] = originalIndices[L[i]].Count;

            var appliedPatterns = new List<Pattern>();
            long[] suffixSum = new long[m];
            bestPattern = new int[m];
            currentPattern = new int[m];

            while (true) {
                int firstIdx = -1;
                for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                    if (available[i] > 0) {
                        firstIdx = i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (firstIdx == -1) break;

                long target = stockLength - L[firstIdx];
                long currentSuffix = 0;
                for (int i = m - 1; i > firstIdx; i--) {
                    long add = L[i] * available[i];
                    if (currentSuffix + add < 0 || currentSuffix + add > target) {
                        currentSuffix = target + 1;
                    } else {
                        currentSuffix += add;
                    }
                    suffixSum[i] = currentSuffix;
                }

                bestSum = -1;
                Array.Clear(bestPattern, 0, m);
                Array.Clear(currentPattern, 0, m);
                iterations = 0;

                SolveKnapsack(firstIdx + 1, 0, target, L, available, suffixSum, m);

                bestPattern[firstIdx]++;

                int times = available[firstIdx];
                for (int i = firstIdx + 1; i < m; i++) {
                    if (bestPattern[i] > 0) {
                        times = Math.Min(times, available[i] / bestPattern[i]);
                    }
                }

                for (int i = firstIdx; i < m; i++) {
                    available[i] -= bestPattern[i] * times;
                }

                appliedPatterns.Add(new Pattern { counts = (int[])bestPattern.Clone(), times = times });
            }

            int totalBins = 0;
            foreach (var p in appliedPatterns) totalBins += p.times;
            writer.WriteLine(totalBins);

            foreach (var p in appliedPatterns) {
                for (int t = 0; t < p.times; t++) {
                    bool first = true;
                    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                        for (int c = 0; c < p.counts[i]; c++) {
                            if (!first) writer.Write(" ");
                            writer.Write(originalIndices[L[i]].Pop());
                            first = false;
                        }
                    }
                    writer.WriteLine();
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Best Fit Decreasing for very large number of distinct sizes
            Array.Sort(cuts);
            var bst = new SortedSet<(long cap, int id)>();
            var bins = new List<List<int>>();

            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                long val = cuts[i].length;
                var view = bst.GetViewBetween((val, -1), (long.MaxValue, int.MaxValue));
                var min = view.Min;
                if (min.cap >= val) {
                    bst.Remove(min);
                    min.cap -= val;
                    bins[min.id].Add(cuts[i].index);
                    bst.Add(min);
                } else {
                    int newId = bins.Count;
                    bins.Add(new List<int> { cuts[i].index });
                    bst.Add((stockLength - val, newId));
                }
            }

            writer.WriteLine(bins.Count);
            foreach (var bin in bins) {
                bool first = true;
                foreach (var idx in bin) {
                    if (!first) writer.Write(" ");
                    writer.Write(idx);
                    first = false;
                }
                writer.WriteLine();
            }
        }
    }

    static void SolveKnapsack(int itemIdx, long currentSum, long target, long[] L, int[] available, long[] suffixSum, int m) {
        if (currentSum == target) {
            bestSum = currentSum;
            Array.Copy(currentPattern, bestPattern, m);
            return;
        }
        if (itemIdx == m) {
            if (currentSum > bestSum) {
                bestSum = currentSum;
                Array.Copy(currentPattern, bestPattern, m);
            }
            return;
        }
        
        iterations++;
        if (iterations > MAX_ITERATIONS) return;

        long maxPossible = currentSum + suffixSum[itemIdx];
        if (maxPossible <= bestSum) return;

        long remainingCap = target - currentSum;
        long maxTakeLong = remainingCap / L[itemIdx];
        int maxTake = (int)Math.Min(maxTakeLong, available[itemIdx]);
        
        for (int take = maxTake; take >= 0; take--) {
            currentPattern[itemIdx] = take;
            SolveKnapsack(itemIdx + 1, currentSum + take * L[itemIdx], target, L, available, suffixSum, m);
            if (bestSum == target) return; 
            if (iterations > MAX_ITERATIONS) return;
        }
    }

    class FastScanner {
        private Stream stream;
        private byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
        private int head, tail;

        public FastScanner(Stream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public int ReadInt() {
            int c = Read();
            while (c <= 32) {
                if (c == -1) return -1;
                c = Read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            while (c > 32) {
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                c = Read();
            }
            return res;
        }

        public long ReadLong() {
            int c = Read();
            while (c <= 32) {
                if (c == -1) return -1;
                c = Read();
            }
            long res = 0;
            while (c > 32) {
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                c = Read();
            }
            return res;
        }

        private int Read() {
            if (head >= tail) {
                head = 0;
                tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
                if (tail == 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[head++];
        }
    }
}

You are solving the 2D Cutting Stock Problem (Rectangle Bin Packing) in C++.

You must write a C++ solver that can handle ANY problem size from trivial to ludicrous scale:

Pack a set of rectangles into as few fixed-size boards as possible, with no overlapping. Rectangles may be rotated 90° to fit better. Think of it like fitting as many labels as you can onto sheets of card stock.

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <random>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;
using namespace std::chrono;

struct Rect {
    int orig_idx;
    int w, h;
    int board_idx;
    int x, y;
    int rotated;
};

struct FreeRect {
    int x, y, w, h;
};

struct Board {
    vector<FreeRect> free_rects;
    long long area_left;
    int max_w, max_h;
};

int N;
int BOARD_W, BOARD_H;
vector<Rect> orig_rects;

struct Solution {
    int num_boards = 1e9;
    long long tie_breaker = -1;
    vector<Rect> rects;
};

Solution best_solution;

inline void recalc_board(Board& b) {
    b.max_w = 0;
    b.max_h = 0;
    for (const auto& fr : b.free_rects) {
        if (fr.w > b.max_w) b.max_w = fr.w;
        if (fr.h > b.max_h) b.max_h = fr.h;
    }
}

inline void calculate_score(int fw, int fh, int w, int h, int place_rule, long long& score1, long long& score2) {
    int dw = fw - w;
    int dh = fh - h;
    if (place_rule == 0) { // BSSF
        score1 = std::min(dw, dh);
        score2 = std::max(dw, dh);
    } else if (place_rule == 1) { // BAF
        score1 = (long long)fw * fh;
        score2 = std::min(dw, dh);
    } else if (place_rule == 2) { // BLSF
        score1 = std::max(dw, dh);
        score2 = std::min(dw, dh);
    }
}

bool pack_item(Rect& item, vector<Board>& boards, int place_rule, int split_rule) {
    long long best_score1 = 3e18;
    long long best_score2 = 3e18;
    int best_board = -1;
    int best_fr_idx = -1;
    int best_rot = 0;
    
    long long item_area = (long long)item.w * item.h;
    
    for (int b = 0; b < (int)boards.size(); b++) {
        if (boards[b].area_left < item_area) continue;
        
        bool can_fit = (item.w <= boards[b].max_w && item.h <= boards[b].max_h) ||
                       (item.h <= boards[b].max_w && item.w <= boards[b].max_h);
        if (!can_fit) continue;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)boards[b].free_rects.size(); i++) {
            const auto& fr = boards[b].free_rects[i];
            
            // Unrotated
            if (item.w <= fr.w && item.h <= fr.h) {
                long long s1, s2;
                calculate_score(fr.w, fr.h, item.w, item.h, place_rule, s1, s2);
                if (s1 < best_score1 || (s1 == best_score1 && s2 < best_score2)) {
                    best_score1 = s1; best_score2 = s2;
                    best_board = b; best_fr_idx = i; best_rot = 0;
                    if (s1 == 0 && s2 == 0) goto found_perfect;
                }
            }
            
            // Rotated
            if (item.h <= fr.w && item.w <= fr.h && item.w != item.h) {
                long long s1, s2;
                calculate_score(fr.w, fr.h, item.h, item.w, place_rule, s1, s2);
                if (s1 < best_score1 || (s1 == best_score1 && s2 < best_score2)) {
                    best_score1 = s1; best_score2 = s2;
                    best_board = b; best_fr_idx = i; best_rot = 1;
                    if (s1 == 0 && s2 == 0) goto found_perfect;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
found_perfect:
    if (best_board == -1) return false;
    
    auto fr = boards[best_board].free_rects[best_fr_idx];
    boards[best_board].free_rects[best_fr_idx] = boards[best_board].free_rects.back();
    boards[best_board].free_rects.pop_back();
    
    int fit_w = best_rot ? item.h : item.w;
    int fit_h = best_rot ? item.w : item.h;
    
    item.board_idx = best_board;
    item.x = fr.x;
    item.y = fr.y;
    item.rotated = best_rot;
    
    FreeRect r1, r2;
    int dw = fr.w - fit_w;
    int dh = fr.h - fit_h;
    bool split_horizontal = false;
    
    if (split_rule == 0) { // SLLA
        split_horizontal = (dw >= dh);
    } else if (split_rule == 1) { // SSLA
        split_horizontal = (dw < dh);
    } else if (split_rule == 2) { // MAXAS
        long long area_horiz = std::max((long long)dw * fit_h, (long long)fr.w * dh);
        long long area_vert  = std::max((long long)fit_w * dh, (long long)dw * fr.h);
        split_horizontal = (area_horiz > area_vert);
    } else { // MINAS
        long long area_horiz = std::max((long long)dw * fit_h, (long long)fr.w * dh);
        long long area_vert  = std::max((long long)fit_w * dh, (long long)dw * fr.h);
        split_horizontal = (area_horiz <= area_vert);
    }
    
    if (split_horizontal) {
        r1 = {fr.x + fit_w, fr.y, dw, fit_h};
        r2 = {fr.x, fr.y + fit_h, fr.w, dh};
    } else {
        r1 = {fr.x, fr.y + fit_h, fit_w, dh};
        r2 = {fr.x + fit_w, fr.y, dw, fr.h};
    }
    
    if (r1.w > 0 && r1.h > 0) boards[best_board].free_rects.push_back(r1);
    if (r2.w > 0 && r2.h > 0) boards[best_board].free_rects.push_back(r2);
    
    boards[best_board].area_left -= item_area;
    recalc_board(boards[best_board]);
    
    return true;
}

template<typename TimePoint>
bool pack_all(vector<Rect>& rects, int place_rule, int split_rule, int& out_boards, long long& out_tie, TimePoint start_time, bool is_first_pass) {
    vector<Board> boards;
    boards.reserve(rects.size());
    out_boards = 0;
    out_tie = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)rects.size(); i++) {
        if (!is_first_pass && (i & 1023) == 0) {
            auto curr_time = high_resolution_clock::now();
            double elapsed = duration_cast<duration<double>>(curr_time - start_time).count();
            if (elapsed > 28.5) {
                return false; 
            }
        }
        
        if (!pack_item(rects[i], boards, place_rule, split_rule)) {
            Board new_board;
            new_board.free_rects.reserve(64);
            new_board.free_rects.push_back({0, 0, BOARD_W, BOARD_H});
            new_board.area_left = (long long)BOARD_W * BOARD_H;
            new_board.max_w = BOARD_W;
            new_board.max_h = BOARD_H;
            boards.push_back(std::move(new_board));
            
            bool ok = pack_item(rects[i], boards, place_rule, split_rule);
            if (!ok) {
                // Should logically never happen with valid constraints
            }
        }
    }
    
    out_boards = boards.size();
    if (out_boards > 0) {
        out_tie = boards.back().area_left;
    }
    return true;
}

void apply_sort(vector<Rect>& rects, int sort_rule, const vector<double>& noise) {
    if (sort_rule == 0) {
        std::sort(rects.begin(), rects.end(), [&](const Rect& a, const Rect& b) {
            double s_a = (long long)a.w * a.h * noise[a.orig_idx];
            double s_b = (long long)b.w * b.h * noise[b.orig_idx];
            return s_a > s_b;
        });
    } else if (sort_rule == 1) {
        std::sort(rects.begin(), rects.end(), [&](const Rect& a, const Rect& b) {
            double max_a = std::max(a.w, a.h) * noise[a.orig_idx];
            double max_b = std::max(b.w, b.h) * noise[b.orig_idx];
            if (max_a != max_b) return max_a > max_b;
            double min_a = std::min(a.w, a.h) * noise[a.orig_idx];
            double min_b = std::min(b.w, b.h) * noise[b.orig_idx];
            return min_a > min_b;
        });
    } else if (sort_rule == 2) {
        std::sort(rects.begin(), rects.end(), [&](const Rect& a, const Rect& b) {
            double s_a = (a.w + a.h) * noise[a.orig_idx];
            double s_b = (b.w + b.h) * noise[b.orig_idx];
            return s_a > s_b;
        });
    } else if (sort_rule == 3) {
        std::sort(rects.begin(), rects.end(), [&](const Rect& a, const Rect& b) {
            double min_a = std::min(a.w, a.h) * noise[a.orig_idx];
            double min_b = std::min(b.w, b.h) * noise[b.orig_idx];
            if (min_a != min_b) return min_a > min_b;
            double max_a = std::max(a.w, a.h) * noise[a.orig_idx];
            double max_b = std::max(b.w, b.h) * noise[b.orig_idx];
            return max_a > max_b;
        });
    } else if (sort_rule == 4) {
        std::sort(rects.begin(), rects.end(), [&](const Rect& a, const Rect& b) {
            double min_a = std::min(a.w, a.h);
            double min_b = std::min(b.w, b.h);
            double ratio_a = (min_a == 0 ? 0 : ((double)std::max(a.w, a.h) / min_a)) * noise[a.orig_idx];
            double ratio_b = (min_b == 0 ? 0 : ((double)std::max(b.w, b.h) / min_b)) * noise[b.orig_idx];
            return ratio_a > ratio_b;
        });
    } else if (sort_rule == 5) {
        std::sort(rects.begin(), rects.end(), [&](const Rect& a, const Rect& b) {
            double area_a = (long long)a.w * a.h * noise[a.orig_idx];
            double area_b = (long long)b.w * b.h * noise[b.orig_idx];
            if (area_a != area_b) return area_a > area_b;
            double max_a = std::max(a.w, a.h) * noise[a.orig_idx];
            double max_b = std::max(b.w, b.h) * noise[b.orig_idx];
            return max_a > max_b;
        });
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    auto start_time = high_resolution_clock::now();
    
    if (!(cin >> N >> BOARD_W >> BOARD_H)) return 0;
    
    orig_rects.resize(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        orig_rects[i].orig_idx = i;
        orig_rects[i].board_idx = -1;
        orig_rects[i].x = 0;
        orig_rects[i].y = 0;
        orig_rects[i].rotated = 0;
        cin >> orig_rects[i].w >> orig_rects[i].h;
    }
    
    int global_best_sort = 0;
    int global_best_place = 0;
    int global_best_split = 0;
    
    vector<double> no_noise(N, 1.0);
    
    for (int sort_rule = 0; sort_rule < 6; sort_rule++) {
        for (int place_rule = 0; place_rule < 3; place_rule++) {
            for (int split_rule = 0; split_rule < 4; split_rule++) {
                auto curr_time = high_resolution_clock::now();
                if (duration_cast<duration<double>>(curr_time - start_time).count() > 28.5) {
                    goto end_deterministic;
                }
                
                vector<Rect> rects = orig_rects;
                apply_sort(rects, sort_rule, no_noise);
                
                int out_boards = 0;
                long long out_tie = 0;
                
                bool is_first = (best_solution.num_boards == 1e9);
                if (pack_all(rects, place_rule, split_rule, out_boards, out_tie, start_time, is_first)) {
                    if (out_boards < best_solution.num_boards || 
                       (out_boards == best_solution.num_boards && out_tie > best_solution.tie_breaker)) {
                        best_solution.num_boards = out_boards;
                        best_solution.tie_breaker = out_tie;
                        best_solution.rects = rects; // copy
                        global_best_sort = sort_rule;
                        global_best_place = place_rule;
                        global_best_split = split_rule;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
end_deterministic:
    
    mt19937 rng(42);
    vector<double> noise(N);
    
    while (true) {
        auto curr_time = high_resolution_clock::now();
        if (duration_cast<duration<double>>(curr_time - start_time).count() > 29.0) {
            break;
        }
        
        double noise_level = 0.01 + (rng() % 100) / 1000.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            noise[i] = 1.0 + (rng() % 10000 - 5000) / 5000.0 * noise_level;
        }
        
        vector<Rect> rects = orig_rects;
        apply_sort(rects, global_best_sort, noise);
        
        int out_boards = 0;
        long long out_tie = 0;
        
        bool is_first = (best_solution.num_boards == 1e9);
        if (pack_all(rects, global_best_place, global_best_split, out_boards, out_tie, start_time, is_first)) {
            if (out_boards < best_solution.num_boards || 
               (out_boards == best_solution.num_boards && out_tie > best_solution.tie_breaker)) {
                best_solution.num_boards = out_boards;
                best_solution.tie_breaker = out_tie;
                best_solution.rects = std::move(rects);
            }
        }
    }
    
    std::sort(best_solution.rects.begin(), best_solution.rects.end(), [](const Rect& a, const Rect& b) {
        return a.orig_idx < b.orig_idx;
    });
    
    if (best_solution.num_boards == 1e9) {
        // Fallback for safety, should never be reached unless input is totally empty
        cout << "0\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    cout << best_solution.num_boards << "\n";
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        cout << best_solution.rects[i].board_idx << " " 
             << best_solution.rects[i].x << " " 
             << best_solution.rects[i].y << " " 
             << best_solution.rects[i].rotated << "\n";
    }
    
    return 0;
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};
use std::f64::consts::PI;

#[derive(Clone)]
struct BBox {
    min_x: f64,
    max_x: f64,
    min_y: f64,
    max_y: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Polygon {
    vertices: Vec<(f64, f64)>,
    bbox: BBox,
    area: f64,
}

fn make_ccw(vertices: &mut Vec<(f64, f64)>) {
    let mut area = 0.0;
    let n = vertices.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let j = (i + 1) % n;
        area += vertices[i].0 * vertices[j].1 - vertices[j].0 * vertices[i].1;
    }
    if area < 0.0 {
        vertices.reverse();
    }
}

impl Polygon {
    fn new(mut vertices: Vec<(f64, f64)>) -> Self {
        make_ccw(&mut vertices);
        let mut min_x = f64::INFINITY;
        let mut max_x = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
        let mut min_y = f64::INFINITY;
        let mut max_y = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
        let mut area = 0.0;
        let n = vertices.len();
        for i in 0..n {
            let p = vertices[i];
            if p.0 < min_x { min_x = p.0; }
            if p.0 > max_x { max_x = p.0; }
            if p.1 < min_y { min_y = p.1; }
            if p.1 > max_y { max_y = p.1; }
            
            let j = (i + 1) % n;
            area += vertices[i].0 * vertices[j].1 - vertices[j].0 * vertices[i].1;
        }
        let bbox = BBox { min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y };
        Polygon { vertices, bbox, area: (area / 2.0).abs() }
    }

    fn translate(&self, dx: f64, dy: f64) -> Polygon {
        let new_verts = self.vertices.iter().map(|&(x, y)| (x + dx, y + dy)).collect();
        Polygon::new(new_verts)
    }
}

struct PieceInput {
    id: usize,
    poly: Polygon,
}

fn bbox_overlap(a: &BBox, b: &BBox) -> bool {
    if a.max_x < b.min_x - 1e-4 || b.max_x < a.min_x - 1e-4 { return false; }
    if a.max_y < b.min_y - 1e-4 || b.max_y < a.min_y - 1e-4 { return false; }
    true
}

fn point_on_segment(px: f64, py: f64, x1: f64, y1: f64, x2: f64, y2: f64) -> bool {
    let cross = (x2 - x1) * (py - y1) - (px - x1) * (y2 - y1);
    let len_sq = (x2 - x1).powi(2) + (y2 - y1).powi(2);
    if len_sq == 0.0 {
        return (px - x1).hypot(py - y1) < 1e-6;
    }
    let dist = cross.abs() / len_sq.sqrt();
    if dist > 1e-4 {
        return false;
    }
    let dot = (px - x1) * (x2 - x1) + (py - y1) * (y2 - y1);
    if dot < -1e-4 || dot > len_sq + 1e-4 {
        return false;
    }
    true
}

fn point_in_polygon(x: f64, y: f64, poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    let mut inside = false;
    let mut j = poly.len() - 1;
    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let (xi, yi) = poly[i];
        let (xj, yj) = poly[j];
        
        if point_on_segment(x, y, xi, yi, xj, yj) {
            return true;
        }

        if ((yi > y) != (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi) {
            inside = !inside;
        }
        j = i;
    }
    inside
}

fn point_strictly_inside(x: f64, y: f64, poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    let mut inside = false;
    let mut j = poly.len() - 1;
    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let (xi, yi) = poly[i];
        let (xj, yj) = poly[j];
        
        if point_on_segment(x, y, xi, yi, xj, yj) {
            return false; 
        }

        if ((yi > y) != (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi) {
            inside = !inside;
        }
        j = i;
    }
    inside
}

fn segments_intersect(p1: (f64, f64), p2: (f64, f64), q1: (f64, f64), q2: (f64, f64)) -> bool {
    fn ccw(a: (f64, f64), b: (f64, f64), c: (f64, f64)) -> f64 {
        (c.1 - a.1) * (b.0 - a.0) - (b.1 - a.1) * (c.0 - a.0)
    }
    let ccw1 = ccw(p1, p2, q1);
    let ccw2 = ccw(p1, p2, q2);
    let ccw3 = ccw(q1, q2, p1);
    let ccw4 = ccw(q1, q2, p2);
    
    if ccw1 * ccw2 < -1e-6 && ccw3 * ccw4 < -1e-6 {
        return true;
    }
    false
}

fn collinear_overlap(p1: (f64, f64), p2: (f64, f64), q1: (f64, f64), q2: (f64, f64)) -> bool {
    let cross1 = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q1.1 - p1.1) - (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q1.0 - p1.0);
    let cross2 = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q2.1 - p1.1) - (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q2.0 - p1.0);
    
    let len_sq = (p2.0 - p1.0).powi(2) + (p2.1 - p1.1).powi(2);
    if len_sq < 1e-7 { return false; }
    let dist1 = cross1.abs() / len_sq.sqrt();
    let dist2 = cross2.abs() / len_sq.sqrt();
    
    if dist1 > 1e-4 || dist2 > 1e-4 {
        return false;
    }
    
    let dot = |a: (f64, f64), b: (f64, f64)| a.0 * b.0 + a.1 * b.1;
    let dir = (p2.0 - p1.0, p2.1 - p1.1);
    
    let t_p1 = dot(p1, dir);
    let t_p2 = dot(p2, dir);
    let t_q1 = dot(q1, dir);
    let t_q2 = dot(q2, dir);
    
    let min_p = t_p1.min(t_p2);
    let max_p = t_p1.max(t_p2);
    let min_q = t_q1.min(t_q2);
    let max_q = t_q1.max(t_q2);
    
    if max_p > min_q + 1e-4 && max_q > min_p + 1e-4 {
        let dot_dir = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q2.0 - q1.0) + (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q2.1 - q1.1);
        if dot_dir > 0.0 {
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

fn polygons_overlap(poly_a: &Polygon, poly_b: &Polygon) -> bool {
    if !bbox_overlap(&poly_a.bbox, &poly_b.bbox) {
        return false;
    }

    for i in 0..poly_a.vertices.len() {
        let p1 = poly_a.vertices[i];
        let p2 = poly_a.vertices[(i + 1) % poly_a.vertices.len()];
        
        let mid = ((p1.0 + p2.0) / 2.0, (p1.1 + p2.1) / 2.0);
        if point_strictly_inside(mid.0, mid.1, &poly_b.vertices) {
            return true;
        }
        if point_strictly_inside(p1.0, p1.1, &poly_b.vertices) {
            return true;
        }

        for j in 0..poly_b.vertices.len() {
            let q1 = poly_b.vertices[j];
            let q2 = poly_b.vertices[(j + 1) % poly_b.vertices.len()];
            
            if segments_intersect(p1, p2, q1, q2) {
                return true; 
            }
            if collinear_overlap(p1, p2, q1, q2) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }

    for i in 0..poly_b.vertices.len() {
        let p1 = poly_b.vertices[i];
        let p2 = poly_b.vertices[(i + 1) % poly_b.vertices.len()];
        let mid = ((p1.0 + p2.0) / 2.0, (p1.1 + p2.1) / 2.0);
        if point_strictly_inside(mid.0, mid.1, &poly_a.vertices) {
            return true;
        }
        if point_strictly_inside(p1.0, p1.1, &poly_a.vertices) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    false
}

fn polygon_inside(poly_a: &Polygon, poly_b: &Polygon) -> bool {
    if poly_a.bbox.min_x < poly_b.bbox.min_x - 1e-4 ||
       poly_a.bbox.max_x > poly_b.bbox.max_x + 1e-4 ||
       poly_a.bbox.min_y < poly_b.bbox.min_y - 1e-4 ||
       poly_a.bbox.max_y > poly_b.bbox.max_y + 1e-4 {
        return false;
    }

    for &p in &poly_a.vertices {
        if !point_in_polygon(p.0, p.1, &poly_b.vertices) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    for i in 0..poly_a.vertices.len() {
        let p1 = poly_a.vertices[i];
        let p2 = poly_a.vertices[(i + 1) % poly_a.vertices.len()];
        let mid = ((p1.0 + p2.0) / 2.0, (p1.1 + p2.1) / 2.0);
        if !point_in_polygon(mid.0, mid.1, &poly_b.vertices) {
            return false;
        }
        
        for j in 0..poly_b.vertices.len() {
            let q1 = poly_b.vertices[j];
            let q2 = poly_b.vertices[(j + 1) % poly_b.vertices.len()];
            
            if segments_intersect(p1, p2, q1, q2) {
                return false;
            }
            
            let cross1 = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q1.1 - p1.1) - (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q1.0 - p1.0);
            let cross2 = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q2.1 - p1.1) - (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q2.0 - p1.0);
            
            let len_sq = (p2.0 - p1.0).powi(2) + (p2.1 - p1.1).powi(2);
            if len_sq > 1e-7 {
                let dist1 = cross1.abs() / len_sq.sqrt();
                let dist2 = cross2.abs() / len_sq.sqrt();
                
                if dist1 < 1e-4 && dist2 < 1e-4 {
                    let dot = |a: (f64, f64), b: (f64, f64)| a.0 * b.0 + a.1 * b.1;
                    let dir = (p2.0 - p1.0, p2.1 - p1.1);
                    
                    let t_p1 = dot(p1, dir);
                    let t_p2 = dot(p2, dir);
                    let t_q1 = dot(q1, dir);
                    let t_q2 = dot(q2, dir);
                    
                    let min_p = t_p1.min(t_p2);
                    let max_p = t_p1.max(t_p2);
                    let min_q = t_q1.min(t_q2);
                    let max_q = t_q1.max(t_q2);
                    
                    if max_p > min_q + 1e-4 && max_q > min_p + 1e-4 {
                        let dot_dir = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q2.0 - q1.0) + (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q2.1 - q1.1);
                        if dot_dir < 0.0 {
                            return false; 
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    true
}

fn rotate_polygon(poly: &Polygon, rad: f64) -> Polygon {
    let cos = rad.cos();
    let sin = rad.sin();
    
    let mut new_verts = Vec::new();
    for &(x, y) in &poly.vertices {
        new_verts.push((x * cos - y * sin, x * sin + y * cos));
    }
    
    let mut p = Polygon::new(new_verts);
    make_ccw(&mut p.vertices);
    p
}

fn enrich_vertices(vertices: &[(f64, f64)]) -> Vec<(f64, f64)> {
    let mut enriched = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..vertices.len() {
        let p1 = vertices[i];
        let p2 = vertices[(i + 1) % vertices.len()];
        enriched.push(p1);
        enriched.push(((p1.0 * 2.0 + p2.0) / 3.0, (p1.1 * 2.0 + p2.1) / 3.0));
        enriched.push(((p1.0 + p2.0 * 2.0) / 3.0, (p1.1 + p2.1 * 2.0) / 3.0));
    }
    enriched
}

fn get_potential_translations(piece: &Polygon, stock: &Polygon, placed_pieces: &[Polygon]) -> Vec<(f64, f64)> {
    let mut translations = Vec::new();
    
    let piece_enrich = enrich_vertices(&piece.vertices);
    let stock_enrich = enrich_vertices(&stock.vertices);
    
    for vp in &piece_enrich {
        for vs in &stock_enrich {
            translations.push((vs.0 - vp.0, vs.1 - vp.1));
        }
    }
    
    let recent_placed: Vec<_> = placed_pieces.iter().rev().take(50).collect();
    for p in recent_placed {
        let p_enrich = enrich_vertices(&p.vertices);
        for vp in &piece_enrich {
            for vo in &p_enrich {
                translations.push((vo.0 - vp.0, vo.1 - vp.1));
            }
        }
    }
    
    let bbox = &stock.bbox;
    let w = bbox.max_x - bbox.min_x;
    let h = bbox.max_y - bbox.min_y;
    
    let step = if placed_pieces.len() > 2000 {
        (w.max(h)) / 2.0
    } else if placed_pieces.len() > 200 {
        (w.max(h)) / 5.0
    } else {
        (w.max(h)) / 20.0
    };
    
    if step > 0.1 {
        let mut x = bbox.min_x;
        while x <= bbox.max_x {
            let mut y = bbox.min_y;
            while y <= bbox.max_y {
                translations.push((x - piece.bbox.min_x, y - piece.bbox.min_y));
                y += step;
            }
            x += step;
        }
    }
    
    translations.push((0.0, 0.0));
    
    translations.sort_by(|a, b| {
        let y_cmp = a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal);
        if y_cmp == std::cmp::Ordering::Equal {
            a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
        } else {
            y_cmp
        }
    });
    
    translations.dedup_by(|a, b| (a.0 - b.0).abs() < 1e-4 && (a.1 - b.1).abs() < 1e-4);
    
    translations.retain(|&(tx, ty)| {
        let p_min_x = piece.bbox.min_x + tx;
        let p_max_x = piece.bbox.max_x + tx;
        let p_min_y = piece.bbox.min_y + ty;
        let p_max_y = piece.bbox.max_y + ty;
        
        p_min_x >= stock.bbox.min_x - 1e-2 &&
        p_max_x <= stock.bbox.max_x + 1e-2 &&
        p_min_y >= stock.bbox.min_y - 1e-2 &&
        p_max_y <= stock.bbox.max_y + 1e-2
    });
    
    translations
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines().filter_map(Result::ok);
    
    let first_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(l) => l,
        None => return,
    };
    let parts: Vec<usize> = first_line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
    let sv = parts[0];
    let np = parts[1];
    
    let mut stock_vertices = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..sv {
        let line = lines.next().unwrap();
        let parts: Vec<f64> = line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
        stock_vertices.push((parts[0], parts[1]));
    }
    let stock_poly = Polygon::new(stock_vertices);
    
    let mut pieces = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..np {
        let pv: usize = lines.next().unwrap().trim().parse().unwrap();
        let mut p_verts = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..pv {
            let line = lines.next().unwrap();
            let parts: Vec<f64> = line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
            p_verts.push((parts[0], parts[1]));
        }
        pieces.push(PieceInput {
            id: i,
            poly: Polygon::new(p_verts),
        });
    }
    
    pieces.sort_by(|a, b| b.poly.area.partial_cmp(&a.poly.area).unwrap());
    
    let mut stocks: Vec<Vec<Polygon>> = Vec::new();
    let mut placements = vec![None; np];
    
    let angles = vec![0.0, PI/2.0, PI, 3.0*PI/2.0];

    for piece_in in pieces {
        let mut placed = false;
        
        let mut rotated_pieces = Vec::new();
        for &angle in &angles {
            rotated_pieces.push((angle, rotate_polygon(&piece_in.poly, angle)));
        }
        
        for stock_idx in 0..stocks.len() {
            let placed_in_stock = &stocks[stock_idx];
            
            for (angle, r_piece) in &rotated_pieces {
                let translations = get_potential_translations(r_piece, &stock_poly, placed_in_stock);
                for &(tx, ty) in &translations {
                    let translated = r_piece.translate(tx, ty);
                    
                    if polygon_inside(&translated, &stock_poly) {
                        let mut overlap = false;
                        for p in placed_in_stock {
                            if polygons_overlap(&translated, p) {
                                overlap = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if !overlap {
                            placements[piece_in.id] = Some((stock_idx, tx, ty, *angle));
                            stocks[stock_idx].push(translated);
                            placed = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if placed { break; }
            }
            if placed { break; }
        }
        
        if !placed {
            let stock_idx = stocks.len();
            stocks.push(Vec::new());
            
            for (angle, r_piece) in &rotated_pieces {
                let translations = get_potential_translations(r_piece, &stock_poly, &stocks[stock_idx]);
                for &(tx, ty) in &translations {
                    let translated = r_piece.translate(tx, ty);
                    if polygon_inside(&translated, &stock_poly) {
                        placements[piece_in.id] = Some((stock_idx, tx, ty, *angle));
                        stocks[stock_idx].push(translated);
                        placed = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if placed { break; }
            }
        }
    }
    
    println!("{}", stocks.len());
    for i in 0..np {
        let (s_idx, tx, ty, rot) = placements[i].unwrap();
        println!("{} {} {} {}", s_idx, tx, ty, rot);
    }
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};
use std::f64::consts::PI;

#[derive(Clone)]
struct BBox {
    min_x: f64,
    max_x: f64,
    min_y: f64,
    max_y: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Polygon {
    vertices: Vec<(f64, f64)>,
    bbox: BBox,
    area: f64,
}

fn make_ccw(vertices: &mut Vec<(f64, f64)>) {
    let mut area = 0.0;
    let n = vertices.len();
    for i in 0..n {
        let j = (i + 1) % n;
        area += vertices[i].0 * vertices[j].1 - vertices[j].0 * vertices[i].1;
    }
    if area < 0.0 {
        vertices.reverse();
    }
}

impl Polygon {
    fn new(mut vertices: Vec<(f64, f64)>) -> Self {
        make_ccw(&mut vertices);
        let mut min_x = f64::INFINITY;
        let mut max_x = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
        let mut min_y = f64::INFINITY;
        let mut max_y = f64::NEG_INFINITY;
        let mut area = 0.0;
        let n = vertices.len();
        for i in 0..n {
            let p = vertices[i];
            if p.0 < min_x { min_x = p.0; }
            if p.0 > max_x { max_x = p.0; }
            if p.1 < min_y { min_y = p.1; }
            if p.1 > max_y { max_y = p.1; }
            
            let j = (i + 1) % n;
            area += vertices[i].0 * vertices[j].1 - vertices[j].0 * vertices[i].1;
        }
        let bbox = BBox { min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y };
        Polygon { vertices, bbox, area: (area / 2.0).abs() }
    }

    fn translate(&self, dx: f64, dy: f64) -> Polygon {
        let new_verts = self.vertices.iter().map(|&(x, y)| (x + dx, y + dy)).collect();
        Polygon::new(new_verts)
    }
}

struct PieceInput {
    id: usize,
    poly: Polygon,
}

fn bbox_overlap(a: &BBox, b: &BBox) -> bool {
    if a.max_x < b.min_x - 1e-4 || b.max_x < a.min_x - 1e-4 { return false; }
    if a.max_y < b.min_y - 1e-4 || b.max_y < a.min_y - 1e-4 { return false; }
    true
}

fn point_on_segment(px: f64, py: f64, x1: f64, y1: f64, x2: f64, y2: f64) -> bool {
    let cross = (x2 - x1) * (py - y1) - (px - x1) * (y2 - y1);
    let len_sq = (x2 - x1).powi(2) + (y2 - y1).powi(2);
    if len_sq == 0.0 {
        return (px - x1).hypot(py - y1) < 1e-6;
    }
    let dist = cross.abs() / len_sq.sqrt();
    if dist > 1e-4 {
        return false;
    }
    let dot = (px - x1) * (x2 - x1) + (py - y1) * (y2 - y1);
    if dot < -1e-4 || dot > len_sq + 1e-4 {
        return false;
    }
    true
}

fn point_in_polygon(x: f64, y: f64, poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    let mut inside = false;
    let mut j = poly.len() - 1;
    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let (xi, yi) = poly[i];
        let (xj, yj) = poly[j];
        
        if point_on_segment(x, y, xi, yi, xj, yj) {
            return true;
        }

        if ((yi > y) != (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi) {
            inside = !inside;
        }
        j = i;
    }
    inside
}

fn point_strictly_inside(x: f64, y: f64, poly: &[(f64, f64)]) -> bool {
    let mut inside = false;
    let mut j = poly.len() - 1;
    for i in 0..poly.len() {
        let (xi, yi) = poly[i];
        let (xj, yj) = poly[j];
        
        if point_on_segment(x, y, xi, yi, xj, yj) {
            return false; 
        }

        if ((yi > y) != (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi) {
            inside = !inside;
        }
        j = i;
    }
    inside
}

fn segments_intersect(p1: (f64, f64), p2: (f64, f64), q1: (f64, f64), q2: (f64, f64)) -> bool {
    fn ccw(a: (f64, f64), b: (f64, f64), c: (f64, f64)) -> f64 {
        (c.1 - a.1) * (b.0 - a.0) - (b.1 - a.1) * (c.0 - a.0)
    }
    let ccw1 = ccw(p1, p2, q1);
    let ccw2 = ccw(p1, p2, q2);
    let ccw3 = ccw(q1, q2, p1);
    let ccw4 = ccw(q1, q2, p2);
    
    if ccw1 * ccw2 < -1e-6 && ccw3 * ccw4 < -1e-6 {
        return true;
    }
    false
}

fn collinear_overlap(p1: (f64, f64), p2: (f64, f64), q1: (f64, f64), q2: (f64, f64)) -> bool {
    let cross1 = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q1.1 - p1.1) - (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q1.0 - p1.0);
    let cross2 = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q2.1 - p1.1) - (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q2.0 - p1.0);
    
    let len_sq = (p2.0 - p1.0).powi(2) + (p2.1 - p1.1).powi(2);
    if len_sq < 1e-7 { return false; }
    let dist1 = cross1.abs() / len_sq.sqrt();
    let dist2 = cross2.abs() / len_sq.sqrt();
    
    if dist1 > 1e-4 || dist2 > 1e-4 {
        return false;
    }
    
    let dot = |a: (f64, f64), b: (f64, f64)| a.0 * b.0 + a.1 * b.1;
    let dir = (p2.0 - p1.0, p2.1 - p1.1);
    
    let t_p1 = dot(p1, dir);
    let t_p2 = dot(p2, dir);
    let t_q1 = dot(q1, dir);
    let t_q2 = dot(q2, dir);
    
    let min_p = t_p1.min(t_p2);
    let max_p = t_p1.max(t_p2);
    let min_q = t_q1.min(t_q2);
    let max_q = t_q1.max(t_q2);
    
    if max_p > min_q + 1e-4 && max_q > min_p + 1e-4 {
        let dot_dir = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q2.0 - q1.0) + (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q2.1 - q1.1);
        if dot_dir > 0.0 {
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

fn polygons_overlap(poly_a: &Polygon, poly_b: &Polygon) -> bool {
    if !bbox_overlap(&poly_a.bbox, &poly_b.bbox) {
        return false;
    }

    for i in 0..poly_a.vertices.len() {
        let p1 = poly_a.vertices[i];
        let p2 = poly_a.vertices[(i + 1) % poly_a.vertices.len()];
        
        let mid = ((p1.0 + p2.0) / 2.0, (p1.1 + p2.1) / 2.0);
        if point_strictly_inside(mid.0, mid.1, &poly_b.vertices) {
            return true;
        }
        if point_strictly_inside(p1.0, p1.1, &poly_b.vertices) {
            return true;
        }

        for j in 0..poly_b.vertices.len() {
            let q1 = poly_b.vertices[j];
            let q2 = poly_b.vertices[(j + 1) % poly_b.vertices.len()];
            
            if segments_intersect(p1, p2, q1, q2) {
                return true; 
            }
            if collinear_overlap(p1, p2, q1, q2) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }

    for i in 0..poly_b.vertices.len() {
        let p1 = poly_b.vertices[i];
        let p2 = poly_b.vertices[(i + 1) % poly_b.vertices.len()];
        let mid = ((p1.0 + p2.0) / 2.0, (p1.1 + p2.1) / 2.0);
        if point_strictly_inside(mid.0, mid.1, &poly_a.vertices) {
            return true;
        }
        if point_strictly_inside(p1.0, p1.1, &poly_a.vertices) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    
    false
}

fn polygon_inside(poly_a: &Polygon, poly_b: &Polygon) -> bool {
    if poly_a.bbox.min_x < poly_b.bbox.min_x - 1e-4 ||
       poly_a.bbox.max_x > poly_b.bbox.max_x + 1e-4 ||
       poly_a.bbox.min_y < poly_b.bbox.min_y - 1e-4 ||
       poly_a.bbox.max_y > poly_b.bbox.max_y + 1e-4 {
        return false;
    }

    for &p in &poly_a.vertices {
        if !point_in_polygon(p.0, p.1, &poly_b.vertices) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    for i in 0..poly_a.vertices.len() {
        let p1 = poly_a.vertices[i];
        let p2 = poly_a.vertices[(i + 1) % poly_a.vertices.len()];
        let mid = ((p1.0 + p2.0) / 2.0, (p1.1 + p2.1) / 2.0);
        if !point_in_polygon(mid.0, mid.1, &poly_b.vertices) {
            return false;
        }
        
        for j in 0..poly_b.vertices.len() {
            let q1 = poly_b.vertices[j];
            let q2 = poly_b.vertices[(j + 1) % poly_b.vertices.len()];
            
            if segments_intersect(p1, p2, q1, q2) {
                return false;
            }
            
            let cross1 = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q1.1 - p1.1) - (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q1.0 - p1.0);
            let cross2 = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q2.1 - p1.1) - (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q2.0 - p1.0);
            
            let len_sq = (p2.0 - p1.0).powi(2) + (p2.1 - p1.1).powi(2);
            if len_sq > 1e-7 {
                let dist1 = cross1.abs() / len_sq.sqrt();
                let dist2 = cross2.abs() / len_sq.sqrt();
                
                if dist1 < 1e-4 && dist2 < 1e-4 {
                    let dot = |a: (f64, f64), b: (f64, f64)| a.0 * b.0 + a.1 * b.1;
                    let dir = (p2.0 - p1.0, p2.1 - p1.1);
                    
                    let t_p1 = dot(p1, dir);
                    let t_p2 = dot(p2, dir);
                    let t_q1 = dot(q1, dir);
                    let t_q2 = dot(q2, dir);
                    
                    let min_p = t_p1.min(t_p2);
                    let max_p = t_p1.max(t_p2);
                    let min_q = t_q1.min(t_q2);
                    let max_q = t_q1.max(t_q2);
                    
                    if max_p > min_q + 1e-4 && max_q > min_p + 1e-4 {
                        let dot_dir = (p2.0 - p1.0) * (q2.0 - q1.0) + (p2.1 - p1.1) * (q2.1 - q1.1);
                        if dot_dir < 0.0 {
                            return false; 
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    true
}

fn rotate_polygon(poly: &Polygon, rad: f64) -> Polygon {
    let cos = rad.cos();
    let sin = rad.sin();
    
    let mut new_verts = Vec::new();
    for &(x, y) in &poly.vertices {
        new_verts.push((x * cos - y * sin, x * sin + y * cos));
    }
    
    let mut p = Polygon::new(new_verts);
    make_ccw(&mut p.vertices);
    p
}

fn enrich_vertices(vertices: &[(f64, f64)]) -> Vec<(f64, f64)> {
    let mut enriched = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..vertices.len() {
        let p1 = vertices[i];
        let p2 = vertices[(i + 1) % vertices.len()];
        enriched.push(p1);
        enriched.push(((p1.0 * 2.0 + p2.0) / 3.0, (p1.1 * 2.0 + p2.1) / 3.0));
        enriched.push(((p1.0 + p2.0 * 2.0) / 3.0, (p1.1 + p2.1 * 2.0) / 3.0));
    }
    enriched
}

fn get_potential_translations(piece: &Polygon, stock: &Polygon, placed_pieces: &[Polygon]) -> Vec<(f64, f64)> {
    let mut translations = Vec::new();
    
    let piece_enrich = enrich_vertices(&piece.vertices);
    let stock_enrich = enrich_vertices(&stock.vertices);
    
    for vp in &piece_enrich {
        for vs in &stock_enrich {
            translations.push((vs.0 - vp.0, vs.1 - vp.1));
        }
    }
    
    let recent_placed: Vec<_> = placed_pieces.iter().rev().take(50).collect();
    for p in recent_placed {
        let p_enrich = enrich_vertices(&p.vertices);
        for vp in &piece_enrich {
            for vo in &p_enrich {
                translations.push((vo.0 - vp.0, vo.1 - vp.1));
            }
        }
    }
    
    let bbox = &stock.bbox;
    let w = bbox.max_x - bbox.min_x;
    let h = bbox.max_y - bbox.min_y;
    
    let step = if placed_pieces.len() > 2000 {
        (w.max(h)) / 2.0
    } else if placed_pieces.len() > 200 {
        (w.max(h)) / 5.0
    } else {
        (w.max(h)) / 20.0
    };
    
    if step > 0.1 {
        let mut x = bbox.min_x;
        while x <= bbox.max_x {
            let mut y = bbox.min_y;
            while y <= bbox.max_y {
                translations.push((x - piece.bbox.min_x, y - piece.bbox.min_y));
                y += step;
            }
            x += step;
        }
    }
    
    translations.push((0.0, 0.0));
    
    translations.sort_by(|a, b| {
        let y_cmp = a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal);
        if y_cmp == std::cmp::Ordering::Equal {
            a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
        } else {
            y_cmp
        }
    });
    
    translations.dedup_by(|a, b| (a.0 - b.0).abs() < 1e-4 && (a.1 - b.1).abs() < 1e-4);
    
    translations.retain(|&(tx, ty)| {
        let p_min_x = piece.bbox.min_x + tx;
        let p_max_x = piece.bbox.max_x + tx;
        let p_min_y = piece.bbox.min_y + ty;
        let p_max_y = piece.bbox.max_y + ty;
        
        p_min_x >= stock.bbox.min_x - 1e-2 &&
        p_max_x <= stock.bbox.max_x + 1e-2 &&
        p_min_y >= stock.bbox.min_y - 1e-2 &&
        p_max_y <= stock.bbox.max_y + 1e-2
    });
    
    translations
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines().filter_map(Result::ok);
    
    let first_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(l) => l,
        None => return,
    };
    let parts: Vec<usize> = first_line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
    let sv = parts[0];
    let np = parts[1];
    
    let mut stock_vertices = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..sv {
        let line = lines.next().unwrap();
        let parts: Vec<f64> = line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
        stock_vertices.push((parts[0], parts[1]));
    }
    let stock_poly = Polygon::new(stock_vertices);
    
    let mut pieces = Vec::new();
    for i in 0..np {
        let pv: usize = lines.next().unwrap().trim().parse().unwrap();
        let mut p_verts = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..pv {
            let line = lines.next().unwrap();
            let parts: Vec<f64> = line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
            p_verts.push((parts[0], parts[1]));
        }
        pieces.push(PieceInput {
            id: i,
            poly: Polygon::new(p_verts),
        });
    }
    
    pieces.sort_by(|a, b| b.poly.area.partial_cmp(&a.poly.area).unwrap());
    
    let mut stocks: Vec<Vec<Polygon>> = Vec::new();
    let mut placements = vec![None; np];
    
    let angles = vec![0.0, PI/2.0, PI, 3.0*PI/2.0];

    for piece_in in pieces {
        let mut placed = false;
        
        let mut rotated_pieces = Vec::new();
        for &angle in &angles {
            rotated_pieces.push((angle, rotate_polygon(&piece_in.poly, angle)));
        }
        
        for stock_idx in 0..stocks.len() {
            let placed_in_stock = &stocks[stock_idx];
            
            for (angle, r_piece) in &rotated_pieces {
                let translations = get_potential_translations(r_piece, &stock_poly, placed_in_stock);
                for &(tx, ty) in &translations {
                    let translated = r_piece.translate(tx, ty);
                    
                    if polygon_inside(&translated, &stock_poly) {
                        let mut overlap = false;
                        for p in placed_in_stock {
                            if polygons_overlap(&translated, p) {
                                overlap = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if !overlap {
                            placements[piece_in.id] = Some((stock_idx, tx, ty, *angle));
                            stocks[stock_idx].push(translated);
                            placed = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if placed { break; }
            }
            if placed { break; }
        }
        
        if !placed {
            let stock_idx = stocks.len();
            stocks.push(Vec::new());
            
            for (angle, r_piece) in &rotated_pieces {
                let translations = get_potential_translations(r_piece, &stock_poly, &stocks[stock_idx]);
                for &(tx, ty) in &translations {
                    let translated = r_piece.translate(tx, ty);
                    if polygon_inside(&translated, &stock_poly) {
                        placements[piece_in.id] = Some((stock_idx, tx, ty, *angle));
                        stocks[stock_idx].push(translated);
                        placed = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if placed { break; }
            }
        }
    }
    
    println!("{}", stocks.len());
    for i in 0..np {
        let (s_idx, tx, ty, rot) = placements[i].unwrap();
        println!("{} {} {} {}", s_idx, tx, ty, rot);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Globalization;

namespace BinPacking
{
    public struct Vector3 {
        public double x, y, z;
        public Vector3(double x, double y, double z) { this.x = x; this.y = y; this.z = z; }
        public static Vector3 Cross(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) {
            return new Vector3(
                a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
                a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
                a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x
            );
        }
        public static double Dot(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) {
            return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
        }
        public double Length() {
            return Math.Sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z);
        }
        public Vector3 Normalized() {
            double len = Length();
            if (len < 1e-9) return new Vector3(0,0,0);
            return new Vector3(x/len, y/len, z/len);
        }
    }

    public struct Quat {
        public double w, x, y, z;
        public Quat(double w, double x, double y, double z) {
            this.w = w; this.x = x; this.y = y; this.z = z;
        }
        public static Quat Multiply(Quat q1, Quat q2) {
            return new Quat(
                q1.w * q2.w - q1.x * q2.x - q1.y * q2.y - q1.z * q2.z,
                q1.w * q2.x + q1.x * q2.w + q1.y * q2.z - q1.z * q2.y,
                q1.w * q2.y - q1.x * q2.z + q1.y * q2.w + q1.z * q2.x,
                q1.w * q2.z + q1.x * q2.y - q1.y * q2.x + q1.z * q2.w
            );
        }
        public static Vector3 Rotate(Quat q, Vector3 v) {
            Quat qv = new Quat(0, v.x, v.y, v.z);
            Quat qInv = new Quat(q.w, -q.x, -q.y, -q.z);
            Quat qres = Multiply(Multiply(q, qv), qInv);
            return new Vector3(qres.x, qres.y, qres.z);
        }
    }

    class PackingConfig {
        public long Count;
        public long nx, ny, nz;
        public double min_x, min_y, min_z;
        public double bw, bh, bd;
        public Quat q;
    }

    enum Scale { Trivial, Medium, Large, Extreme }

    static class QuatHelper {
        public static List<Quat> GetOrthogonalRotations() {
            List<Quat> list = new List<Quat>();
            Queue<Quat> q = new Queue<Quat>();
            Quat id = new Quat(1, 0, 0, 0);
            list.Add(id);
            q.Enqueue(id);
            
            double root2 = Math.Sqrt(0.5);
            Quat[] axes = new Quat[] {
                new Quat(root2, root2, 0, 0),
                new Quat(root2, 0, root2, 0),
                new Quat(root2, 0, 0, root2)
            };
            
            while(q.Count > 0) {
                Quat curr = q.Dequeue();
                foreach (Quat axis in axes) {
                    Quat next = Quat.Multiply(curr, axis);
                    bool found = false;
                    foreach (Quat existing in list) {
                        double dot = existing.w * next.w + existing.x * next.x + existing.y * next.y + existing.z * next.z;
                        if (Math.Abs(dot) > 0.999) { found = true; break; }
                    }
                    if (!found) {
                        list.Add(next);
                        q.Enqueue(next);
                    }
                }
            }
            return list;
        }

        public static List<Quat> GetRandomRotations(int count, int seed = 42) {
            List<Quat> list = new List<Quat>();
            Random rnd = new Random(seed);
            for (int i=0; i<count; i++) {
                double u1 = rnd.NextDouble();
                double u2 = rnd.NextDouble();
                double u3 = rnd.NextDouble();
                double w = Math.Sqrt(1 - u1) * Math.Sin(2 * Math.PI * u2);
                double x = Math.Sqrt(1 - u1) * Math.Cos(2 * Math.PI * u2);
                double y = Math.Sqrt(u1) * Math.Sin(2 * Math.PI * u3);
                double z = Math.Sqrt(u1) * Math.Cos(2 * Math.PI * u3);
                double len = Math.Sqrt(w*w + x*x + y*y + z*z);
                list.Add(new Quat(w/len, x/len, y/len, z/len));
            }
            return list;
        }

        public static List<Quat> GetFaceAlignments(List<Vector3> vertices, List<int[]> faces) {
            List<Quat> rotations = new List<Quat>();
            rotations.Add(new Quat(1, 0, 0, 0));
            
            var faceAreas = new List<Tuple<int[], double>>();
            foreach (var face in faces) {
                if (face.Length >= 3) {
                    Vector3 v0 = vertices[face[0]];
                    Vector3 v1 = vertices[face[1]];
                    Vector3 v2 = vertices[face[2]];
                    Vector3 edge1 = new Vector3(v1.x - v0.x, v1.y - v0.y, v1.z - v0.z);
                    Vector3 edge2 = new Vector3(v2.x - v0.x, v2.y - v0.y, v2.z - v0.z);
                    double area = Vector3.Cross(edge1, edge2).Length();
                    faceAreas.Add(Tuple.Create(face, area));
                }
            }
            
            faceAreas.Sort((a, b) => b.Item2.CompareTo(a.Item2));
            int maxFaces = Math.Min(100, faceAreas.Count);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < maxFaces; i++) {
                var face = faceAreas[i].Item1;
                Vector3 v0 = vertices[face[0]];
                Vector3 v1 = vertices[face[1]];
                Vector3 v2 = vertices[face[2]];
                
                Vector3 edge1 = new Vector3(v1.x - v0.x, v1.y - v0.y, v1.z - v0.z);
                Vector3 edge2 = new Vector3(v2.x - v0.x, v2.y - v0.y, v2.z - v0.z);
                Vector3 normal = Vector3.Cross(edge1, edge2).Normalized();
                
                if (normal.Length() < 0.1) continue;
                
                Vector3 target = new Vector3(0, 0, 1);
                Vector3 axis = Vector3.Cross(normal, target);
                double dot = Vector3.Dot(normal, target);
                
                Quat alignZ;
                if (axis.Length() < 1e-5) {
                    if (dot > 0) {
                        alignZ = new Quat(1, 0, 0, 0);
                    } else {
                        alignZ = new Quat(0, 1, 0, 0); 
                    }
                } else {
                    axis = axis.Normalized();
                    double angle = Math.Acos(Math.Max(-1.0, Math.Min(1.0, dot)));
                    double halfAngle = angle / 2.0;
                    double sin = Math.Sin(halfAngle);
                    alignZ = new Quat(Math.Cos(halfAngle), axis.x * sin, axis.y * sin, axis.z * sin);
                }
                
                Quat z0 = new Quat(1, 0, 0, 0);
                Quat z90 = new Quat(Math.Sqrt(0.5), 0, 0, Math.Sqrt(0.5));
                Quat z180 = new Quat(0, 0, 0, 1);
                Quat z270 = new Quat(Math.Sqrt(0.5), 0, 0, -Math.Sqrt(0.5));
                
                rotations.Add(Quat.Multiply(z0, alignZ));
                rotations.Add(Quat.Multiply(z90, alignZ));
                rotations.Add(Quat.Multiply(z180, alignZ));
                rotations.Add(Quat.Multiply(z270, alignZ));
            }
            return rotations;
        }

        public static List<Quat> UniqueRotations(List<Quat> input) {
            List<Quat> res = new List<Quat>();
            foreach (var q in input) {
                bool duplicate = false;
                foreach (var e in res) {
                    double dot = q.w * e.w + q.x * e.x + q.y * e.y + q.z * e.z;
                    if (Math.Abs(dot) > 0.999) { duplicate = true; break; }
                }
                if (!duplicate) res.Add(q);
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    abstract class PackingStrategy {
        public abstract PackingConfig Pack(List<Vector3> vertices, List<int[]> faces, double W, double H, double D);
        
        protected PackingConfig FindBest(List<Vector3> vertices, IEnumerable<Quat> rotations, double W, double H, double D) {
            PackingConfig best = new PackingConfig { Count = -1 };
            object lockObj = new object();
            
            Parallel.ForEach(rotations, q => {
                var config = EvaluateRotation(vertices, q, W, H, D);
                lock (lockObj) {
                    if (config.Count > best.Count) {
                        best = config;
                    }
                }
            });
            
            return best;
        }
        
        protected PackingConfig EvaluateRotation(List<Vector3> vertices, Quat q, double W, double H, double D) {
            double min_x = double.MaxValue, min_y = double.MaxValue, min_z = double.MaxValue;
            double max_x = double.MinValue, max_y = double.MinValue, max_z = double.MinValue;
            
            foreach (var v in vertices) {
                Vector3 rv = Quat.Rotate(q, v);
                if (rv.x < min_x) min_x = rv.x;
                if (rv.x > max_x) max_x = rv.x;
                if (rv.y < min_y) min_y = rv.y;
                if (rv.y > max_y) max_y = rv.y;
                if (rv.z < min_z) min_z = rv.z;
                if (rv.z > max_z) max_z = rv.z;
            }
            
            double bw = max_x - min_x;
            double bh = max_y - min_y;
            double bd = max_z - min_z;
            
            long nx = bw > 1e-9 ? (long)Math.Floor(W / bw + 1e-9) : 0;
            long ny = bh > 1e-9 ? (long)Math.Floor(H / bh + 1e-9) : 0;
            long nz = bd > 1e-9 ? (long)Math.Floor(D / bd + 1e-9) : 0;
            
            if (nx <= 0 || ny <= 0 || nz <= 0) {
                return new PackingConfig { Count = 0 };
            }
            
            return new PackingConfig { 
                Count = nx * ny * nz, 
                nx = nx, ny = ny, nz = nz,
                min_x = min_x, min_y = min_y, min_z = min_z,
                bw = bw, bh = bh, bd = bd,
                q = q
            };
        }
    }

    class HybridStrategy : PackingStrategy {
        public override PackingConfig Pack(List<Vector3> vertices, List<int[]> faces, double W, double H, double D) {
            List<Quat> rots = new List<Quat>();
            rots.AddRange(QuatHelper.GetOrthogonalRotations());
            rots.AddRange(QuatHelper.GetFaceAlignments(vertices, faces));
            rots.AddRange(QuatHelper.GetRandomRotations(10000, 42));
            return FindBest(vertices, QuatHelper.UniqueRotations(rots), W, H, D);
        }
    }

    class MediumStrategy : PackingStrategy {
        public override PackingConfig Pack(List<Vector3> vertices, List<int[]> faces, double W, double H, double D) {
            List<Quat> rots = new List<Quat>();
            rots.AddRange(QuatHelper.GetOrthogonalRotations());
            rots.AddRange(QuatHelper.GetFaceAlignments(vertices, faces));
            rots.AddRange(QuatHelper.GetRandomRotations(1000, 42));
            return FindBest(vertices, QuatHelper.UniqueRotations(rots), W, H, D);
        }
    }

    class LargeStrategy : PackingStrategy {
        public override PackingConfig Pack(List<Vector3> vertices, List<int[]> faces, double W, double H, double D) {
            List<Quat> rots = new List<Quat>();
            rots.AddRange(QuatHelper.GetOrthogonalRotations());
            rots.AddRange(QuatHelper.GetFaceAlignments(vertices, faces));
            return FindBest(vertices, QuatHelper.UniqueRotations(rots), W, H, D);
        }
    }

    class ExtremeStrategy : PackingStrategy {
        public override PackingConfig Pack(List<Vector3> vertices, List<int[]> faces, double W, double H, double D) {
            List<Quat> rots = new List<Quat>();
            rots.AddRange(QuatHelper.GetOrthogonalRotations());
            return FindBest(vertices, QuatHelper.UniqueRotations(rots), W, H, D);
        }
    }

    class Scanner {
        private readonly StreamReader _reader;
        private string[] _tokens = new string[0];
        private int _pos = 0;

        public Scanner(Stream stream) {
            _reader = new StreamReader(stream, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, true, 65536);
        }

        public string Next() {
            while (_pos >= _tokens.Length) {
                string line = _reader.ReadLine();
                if (line == null) return null;
                _tokens = line.Split(new char[] { ' ', '\t', '\r', '\n' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                _pos = 0;
            }
            return _tokens[_pos++];
        }

        public double NextDouble() {
            return double.Parse(Next(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        public int NextInt() {
            return int.Parse(Next(), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }
    }

    class Program {
        static Scale GetScale(double W, double H, double D) {
            double m = Math.Max(W, Math.Max(H, D));
            if (m <= 5.0) return Scale.Trivial;
            if (m <= 20.0) return Scale.Medium;
            if (m <= 100.0) return Scale.Large;
            return Scale.Extreme;
        }

        static PackingStrategy GetStrategy(Scale scale) {
            switch (scale) {
                case Scale.Trivial: return new HybridStrategy();
                case Scale.Medium: return new MediumStrategy();
                case Scale.Large: return new LargeStrategy();
                case Scale.Extreme: default: return new ExtremeStrategy();
            }
        }

        static void PrintConfig(PackingConfig config) {
            if (config == null || config.Count <= 0) {
                Console.WriteLine("0");
                return;
            }
            
            const long MAX_OUTPUT_LINES = 10_000_000;
            long printCount = Math.Min(config.Count, MAX_OUTPUT_LINES);
            
            using (StreamWriter sw = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false), 65536)) {
                sw.WriteLine(printCount);
                long printed = 0;
                for (long i = 0; i < config.nx && printed < printCount; i++) {
                    for (long j = 0; j < config.ny && printed < printCount; j++) {
                        for (long k = 0; k < config.nz && printed < printCount; k++) {
                            double tx = i * config.bw - config.min_x;
                            double ty = j * config.bh - config.min_y;
                            double tz = k * config.bd - config.min_z;
                            sw.WriteLine($"{tx:F5} {ty:F5} {tz:F5} {config.q.w:F5} {config.q.x:F5} {config.q.y:F5} {config.q.z:F5}");
                            printed++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        static void Main(string[] args) {
            Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
            
            Scanner scanner = new Scanner(Console.OpenStandardInput());
            string vStr = scanner.Next();
            if (vStr == null) return;
            
            int V = int.Parse(vStr, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            int F = scanner.NextInt();
            
            List<Vector3> vertices = new List<Vector3>(V);
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                vertices.Add(new Vector3(scanner.NextDouble(), scanner.NextDouble(), scanner.NextDouble()));
            }
            
            List<int[]> faces = new List<int[]>(F);
            for (int i = 0; i < F; i++) {
                faces.Add(new int[] { scanner.NextInt(), scanner.NextInt(), scanner.NextInt() });
            }
            
            double W = scanner.NextDouble();
            double H = scanner.NextDouble();
            double D = scanner.NextDouble();
            
            Scale scale = GetScale(W, H, D);
            PackingStrategy strategy = GetStrategy(scale);
            PackingConfig bestConfig = strategy.Pack(vertices, faces, W, H, D);
            
            PrintConfig(bestConfig);
        }
    }
}
